programme.title: Kati Kati
programme.desc: When Kaleche, a young amnesiac, wakes up in the middle of the wilderness, she has no idea how she got there. She makes her way to Kati Kati, a nearby lodge, where she meets a motley crew of residents under the leadership of Thoma. As Kaleche strikes up a quick and intense friendship with him, she discovers that there’s a lot more to Thoma and the mysterious Kati Kati.

programme.title: Man of Gold
programme.desc: After inheriting his father's church, Miracle and his friend Tobias venture into the gold delivery business, only to have the gold stolen. Desperate to repay the debt, they hatch a plan to use the church.

programme.title: Ni Sisi
programme.desc: Ni Sisi portrays a typical Kenyan community: a harmonious muddle of tribes, intermarriages, and extended families who have lived and worked together all their lives. Then one day rumors begin to spread and suddenly mistrust takes hold. People are identified as belonging to a different tribe rather than by their identity as a person. With mistrust comes a sense of threat and fear, and old friends now turn on each other. In a matter of days, the bonds and alliances are severed just as it did in reality in 2008. They find themselves plunging into chaos, and it seems unstoppable and brutal. Is it possible to learn from old mistakes and has a once peaceful community another chance?

programme.title: Her Broken Shadow
programme.desc: Two anthropophobic women are struggling to write novels. Adongo lives in East Africa in the near future while Apio lives in a space city in the distant future. They look so alike that one has to be the other’s doppelganger. Both are hermits, estranged from their respective families, and are suffering from loneliness. When the boundary between their worlds collapses, they discover that each is the protagonist in the novel the other is writing. Each believes she is real and the other a fabrication, yet their histories indicate that they might be identical twins, and that one murdered the other. As they struggle to understand the nature of their existence, they fail to tell reality from fantasy, the past from the present, and they have to solve the murder each committed in her childhood to avoid a complete descent into madness.

programme.title: I Bwiza (Tenacity)
programme.desc: Gatoni Maya, a 23-year-old brave girl, is resolved to fulfill her deceased father's dream of making a living through arts. Together with her co-workers in an artist collective named I Bwiza, she fights the injustice against artists by confronting Myasiro, the owner of the company that sells their arts; all while taking care of her ailing mother’s treatment and her younger brother’s school fees.

programme.title: Minga et la Cuissinière
programme.desc: Minga is an orphaned girl living with her stepmother Mami Kaba and her stepsister Abena. One day, when she was washing dishes in the river, she accidentally broke a spoon. A furious Mami Kaba then chased her away from the house, asking her to find the only identical spoon hidden by her late mother. A adventurous journey then begins for Minga in the forest.

programme.title: Contention
programme.desc: Blood means nothing to the Salami-Bangura siblings, what they desire is power and they would gladly kill each other to get it. The opportunity presents itself upon the death of their parents, leaving the Salami-Bangura empire up for grabs. When the children come together for the first time in years to plan the funeral of their parents, betrayals and ulterior motives become order in their household.

programme.title: Cards on the Table
programme.desc: A Christmas party bash is held in the year 1992 Nairobi. Jackso and Beth, a desperate ex-couple, arrive with a mission to rob the gate collections to meet their pressing needs for money in a tough economy. When they arrive at the event, they break into an argument due to layers upon layers of unresolved issues, this attracts the attention of the police and they end up as â€˜state guestsâ€™ at a police station under a relentless Inspector Kip.

programme.desc: She used to live in Lagos, Nigeria and run industrial sabotage for a Nigerian conglomerate until she got married and moved to the suburbs. Now she's a bored housewife and her company wants her back for one last job. She accepts against the wishes of her husband who then decides to sabotage the project in an attempt to save their marriage.

programme.title: Dara
programme.desc: In Port Harcourt, ambitious university creative Idara, known on campus as Dara, has built a reputation on charisma, talent, and rising social-media fame. His life takes a dangerous turn when he falls for Sophie, a brilliant young woman already desired by Agama, the ruthless leader of a violent campus brotherhood that controls the university through intimidation and force. Daraâ€™s open affection is seen as a direct challenge to Agamaâ€™s authority. What begins as campus rivalry quickly escalates into public humiliation, calculated threats, and brutal assault. Pressured to join rival factions for protection, Dara refuses to surrender his identity or his love. As pride collides with power and loyalty fractures under fear, Dara is pushed toward a breaking point that will change everything.

programme.title: The Arbitration
programme.desc: An Arbitration panel is constituted to find out the truth when the CEO of a company who has an affair with his employee is being sued and accused of raping her.

programme.title: Coming to Africa: Welcome to Ghana
programme.desc: Ghanaian schoolteacher Akosua, planning to move to the U.S. with her new boyfriend Adrian, faces resistance from her students upon revealing her departure and doubts about Adrian's fidelity. Simultaneously, Adrian's brother explores business opportunities in Ghana, leading to unexpected connections, while Akosua's sister devises a plan to address their family's challenges, all set against the backdrop of familial tensions and hidden dangers.

programme.title: Poker
programme.desc: The story through the main character, Tamara, enables the viewer to get inside the lives of married ladies who live with the scourge of marital violence across the world and learn what makes them tick.

programme.title: Nkinzi
programme.desc: Nkinzi follows an eight-year-old girl who runs away from home and finds refuge in Kampala’s streets, where she meets Junior, a street-smart kid, and his sister Princess. Together, they face urban hardships and form a deep bond on their journey to reunite her with her family. This heartfelt film explores empathy, resilience, and the power of friendship, shedding light on child welfare and the enduring strength of hope and human connection.

programme.title: Funny Universe
programme.desc: Ese has a striking resemblance to Mrs. Bucknor's lost daughter, Mrs. Bucknor's protege Festus employs Ese to pretend to be Mrs. Bucknor's long lost granddaughter so he can steal all of her wealth.

programme.title: It's A Free Country

programme.title: Our Tomorrow
programme.desc: Our Tomorrow" is a powerful drama set in Kenya, where the rapid acquisition of land by investors has left many without a home. The film follows the journey of Kim (David Ochiel) as he seeks justice for the murder of his father. With the help of his friends Dante (Kennedy Gitagia) and Ryan (Lad Mambili), they take on the powerful and ruthless land developer, Rose (Cynthia Bonareri). As the stakes get higher, the trio must navigate corrupt officials, dangerous thugs, and their own personal demons to uncover the truth and reclaim their land. "Our Tomorrow" will take you on an emotional journey as the characters fight for their rights and for a better future for themselves and their community. Will they succeed or will they become another statistic in the fight for land rights? "Our Tomorrow" is a story of hope, friendship and the determination to build a better future.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E01
programme.desc: After frontiersman Daniel Boone forges paths across the Appalachian Mountains and into the newly discovered lands of Kentucky, he founds the settlement of Boonesborough, which quickly becomes one of the most important outposts on colonial America's frontier. But this westward expansion comes at a price. Despite agreements made with the powerful Cherokee nation, conflict between the settlers and natives soon rages like wildfire. For Boone, the strife becomes intensely personal when his daughter and two other young women are abducted by Hanging Maw, a fearsome Cherokee chief. In a desperate chase, Boone pursues Hanging Maw's warriors and their captives through untamed wilderness, with his daughter's life hanging in the balance.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - S05 E03
programme.desc: The cowboys are deep in the heart of Texas! In this episode of The Cowboy Way, the guys try to cash in on a cattle bounty roundup: hard cash for each cow they catch. But this money ain't easy thanks to a sprawling 500-acre ranch covered in mesquite brush with razor-sharp thorns. Just when the cowboys think they've found a promising Texas cattle connection, Booger makes a big mistake that could jeopardize their first meeting with a hard-nosed rancher. Back in Alabama, Bubba and Kaley's house guest is beginning to overstay his welcome. As they try to teach Andrew the Thompson house rules, he commits the biggest cowboy sin of all - messing with Bubba's grill! Booger, Jaclyn, and Matthew care for a new-born calf. Misty has a special surprise for Cody. An offer to travel back to Texas for another cattle drive doesn't thrill the cowboys, but they begin to consider the networking potential and how it might make their cattle-trading dreams come true.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E11
programme.desc: Bret Maverick is attacked on a riverboat and set adrift in a dinghy, eventually floating to a dock on a secluded island. The island's residents fear Bret is a spy and take him prisoner, but he soon convinces them otherwise.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E09
programme.desc: Cheyenne faces issues in a small town, including a dry well and anxiety from townspeople, which leads to an uprising. As sheriff, he tries to keep the peace, but the formation of a lynch mob forces him to shoot and kill a prominent citizen's son.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E10
programme.desc: Cheyenne returns a young white man named Mickey, who was kidnapped by the Apaches when he was a child. Problems arise when Mickey's family isn't accepting of his Mexican wife. Mickey rebels against his family, and Cheyenne tries to save his marriage.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E24
programme.desc: While hauling dynamite, Lucas accidentally creates a spark, leading to an explosion. He is blinded and Doc Burrage isn't sure if he will regain his sight. When an enemy from Lucas' past shows up in town, he is in danger, as the man aims to kill him.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E25
programme.desc: When two ex-Confederate officers come to town, trouble ensues for Lucas as he was a lieutenant in the 8th Indiana which defeated the 12th Cavalry 15 years ago. The beaten men were sent to a Union prison camp and now want revenge on Lucas.

programme.title: Maverick_S05_E04.mp4 (Segment 1)
programme.desc: No program description

programme.title: Maverick - S03 E20
programme.desc: Bret Maverick goes to Guatemala City to follow the woman he loves, Ellen Johnson, whom he fears may be linked to a million-dollar jewel theft. After arriving, he meets a clever young street kid named Angelita who becomes his guide to help find Ellen.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S07 E04
programme.desc: Cheyenne finds a young, injured cowboy who is suffering from amnesia. Cheyenne takes him to the doctor and then leaves to investigate a murder and bank robbery. Cheyenne suspects that the young man could be involved.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E18
programme.desc: Abel Goss is doing a portrait of Mark standing on a North Fork street. Suddenly he sees Colonel Whiteside and his sidekick, Jamison. When he recognizes them as the cruel men who tortured him in a Civil War prison camp, problems soon arise.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E19
programme.desc: A young couple traveling to Yuma to get married come across Aaron Pelser's wagon train. Pelser and his group take things too far by forcing them to marry in North Fork, which is not the friendly spirit for a shivaree. Lucas steps in to help.

programme.title: F Troop - S02 E12
programme.desc: An Italian man, Emilio Barberini, and his beautiful daughter, Gina, visit the F Troop at Fort Courage. Her beauty attracts the attention of every man, but her hot-headed suitor is pursuing her and swears vengeance on anyone who even glances her way.

programme.title: F Troop - S02 E13
programme.desc: A gunman known as Kid Vicious, who looks exactly like Captain Wilton Parmenter, arrives at Fort Courage. Wrangler Jane initially thinks he is the captain but after he terrorizes the F Troop, Parmenter shows his leadership and confronts the intruder.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S02 E07
programme.desc: In his first week on the job as the new constable of Jerome, Arizona, Jim Roberts gets to work arresting the town's troublemakers and teaching his timid deputy how to be a courageous lawman as they track down a stone-cold killer and his gang.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S02 E08
programme.desc: In an odd twist of fate, photographers C.S. and Mollie Fly decide to open a studio next to a dusty corral in Tombstone, Arizona, and they end up taking the last shot of the Old West's most infamous gunbattle, the Shootout at the O.K. Corral.

programme.desc: No program description

programme.title: Maverick - S03 E21
programme.desc: Bart Maverick runs for senator in Silverdale after rescuing Reform Party candidate Ellsworth Greeley from an assassination attempt. Bart's campaign run becomes dangerous when his enemies intend to kill him if he wins, forcing him to throw the race.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S07 E05
programme.desc: On his stop to pick up prisoners for Huntsville, Cheyenne learns of Deputy Gary Thomas' conviction of a crime. He believes that the banker's son, Jud Ainley is behind Thomas' arrest and begins unraveling the truth.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E20
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, 16 year-old Donnel O'Mahoney panics and comes to the McCain Ranch. A posse is on the hunt for the young man, believing he commited the crime. Mark befriends and hides O'Mahoney, who is traveling west from New York.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E21
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Sam Buckhart escorts an Indian prisoner back east to stand trial. They arrive in North Fork and Lucas finds out that Buckhart is also an Indian who was educated at Harvard. Angry townspeople try to take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: F Troop - S02 E14
programme.desc: The jinxed cavalryman, Wrongo Starr, comes back to Fort Courage. However, this time he is making the F Troop very nervous with a load of dynamite in his possession. While there, he gets mixed up with a goat after Parmenter assigns him as a guard.

programme.title: F Troop - S02 E15
programme.desc: An army captain arrives at Fort Courage and tells Captain Permenter that two troops must undergo a survival test in the wilderness. Parmenter decides to go with Agarn. Realizing they must survive on their own, the two face challenges finding food.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S02 E09
programme.desc: It's not gold that inspires a rush of treasure hunters to flood the windblown bluffs of Wyoming: it's bones. After stumbling upon a strange fossil, a man is caught in the crossfire of rival paleontologists warring over a trove of dinosaur bones.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S02 E10
programme.desc: When failed prospector John Hicks Adams is elected sheriff of Santa Clara County, he must prove that he won't be a bust as a lawman too. Just weeks into the job, his courage is tested when a band of stagecoach robbers begins terrorizing the area.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E02
programme.desc: Under orders from President Jefferson to explore America's vast unknown frontier, Meriwether Lewis and William Clark lead an expedition up the Missouri River in an attempt to reach the Pacific Ocean...a journey no American has made before, and one that may not even be possible. Leaving Fort Mandan after their first winter on the frontier, the Corps of Discovery enters completely uncharted territory. But as the waterways they travel become too shallow for boats, Lewis and Clark desperately seek the Shoshone tribe and their horses. To communicate with the elusive tribe, they rely on Sacagawea, a 16-year-old Shoshone woman, who accompanies the expedition with her newborn son. Lewis and Clark hope Sacagawea will help them trade for the Shoshone's horses, which will provide the only means of crossing the forbidding Rocky Mountains before winter returns.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - S05 E04
programme.desc: First, the cowboys need to track down one of Bubba's most troublesome heifers before she can bust through his fence again. After briefly tending to business and family in Alabama, the guys head back to the Lone Star State to try and expand their network of contacts. Bubba, Cody, and Booger help their new friend Cash with a big Texas cattle drive in the hopes of both leading the herd to greener pastures and finding the big cattle deal they came west for. On the range they forge deeper bonds with their Texas counterparts, swapping cowboy stories around the campfire. But things take a turn for the worse when the herd overheats, and the creek they're all counting on has run dry as a bone. Back home, Jaclyn and Matthew are learning to love life on the ranch. Houseguest Andrew's disgusting habits have Kaley seeing red. And just as Misty gets back in the barrel-racing saddle, she starts to butt heads with her high-strung mare.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E12
programme.desc: Bart Maverick suffers a broken leg after a mountain lion spooks his horse. He recuperates at the secluded Star Trail Ranch owned by Pete Stillman. However, Pete's wife, Kitty, is enamored with Bart and develops a different plan of her own for him.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E11
programme.desc: After his friend passes away, Cheyenne becomes the marshal of Cripple Creek. Disgusted by all the corruption in the small town, he resigns. His successor arrives but may need Cheyenne's help to keep the peace.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E12
programme.desc: Cheyenne travels to Emmetville for his friend's wedding. When he arrives in town, he finds out that his friend is missing. Suspicious arise around the tight-lipped Emmet family and the bride-to-be who doesn't seemed concerned of his whereabouts.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E26
programme.desc: Traveling salesman Speed Sullivan, and his son, Swifty, come to North Fork selling lightning rods. Sullivan makes a call at Vashti Croxton's home where he finds her unconscious. When she blames Sullivan for the assault, Lucas must intervene.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E27
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark travel to a nearby town to sell a bull. While in town, they buy two horses from Mr. Schneider, a man in a hurry. When a posse stops Lucas and Mark on the way home, Lucas learns the horses were stolen. The men want Lucas to hang.

programme.desc: No program description

programme.title: Maverick - S03 E22
programme.desc: Bret Maverick wins a massive sheep herd in a poker game from a rancher named Big Coley. However, the sheep are located on territory in the middle of a violent range war. When the cattlemen want his sheep gone, Bret finds a way to fight back.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S07 E06
programme.desc: Sioux brave White Crow needs medical help for his sick wife, Little Fawn. Cheyenne and Doc Farnsworth leave to go see her. When White Crow returns with gold as payment to heal her, the locals want to invade Sioux territory, possibly starting a war.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E22
programme.desc: Julia Andueza opens a boarding house in North Fork. Lucas remembers her as a dishonest card dealer from the past. Her old boss arrives and tries to bully Julia into turning her business into a gambling house. Lucas realizes she has changed her ways.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E23
programme.desc: Lucas' life is in danger after he agrees to testify in a murder case in another town. The only other witness was killed, and when a gun-toting stranger appears at the McCain Ranch, Lucas now finds himself in grave danger.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E06
programme.desc: Bret Maverick travels to Mexico to find a man wanted for murder, then bring him back to New Orleans. He soon finds the supposed killer, a bartender named Steve Corbett. The two become friends, but only after Bret believes in his innocence.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S02 E11
programme.desc: After a bank robbery, two Pinkerton detectives join forces to track the notorious Missouri Kid. During a shootout, the Missouri Kid kills seasoned detective Charles Schumacher, leaving young George Dougherty to finish the job and avenge his death.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E01
programme.desc: Unable to apprehend the train-robbing Smith Brothers, Sheriff Doc Shores calls the Pinkerton Detective Agency for assistance. The agency sends Charles Siringo, an undercover specialist known for his unorthodox methods of capturing criminals.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E03
programme.desc: As a member of Lewis and Clark's Corps of Discovery, John Colter travels from the Missouri River all the way to the Pacific Ocean, but he decides not to return to the civilized East when the expedition ends. Entranced by the beauty and adventure of the wild frontier, he becomes one of America's first mountain men. As a hunter, trapper and explorer in his own right, he's the first American to see the Grand Tetons and the epic Yellowstone Valley. While his epic explorations make him famous, it's a harrowing ordeal with Blackfeet warriors that makes him a legend. After boldly venturing into territory controlled by the Blackfeet tribe, Colter is captured, stripped naked, and forced to run for his life as warriors give chase in what will come to be known as Colter's Run.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - S05 E05
programme.desc: Bubba, Booger and Cody take an important step toward becoming big-time cattle brokers! The guys are roping and doctoring yearlings on the Texas range. But when Booger's most reliable horse Studly trips, smashing both horse and rider to the ground, Booger must rush out to find a vet and tend to his injured horse. Just as the cowboys are about to leave Texas, a local rancher makes them an offer they can't refuse. Will the guys gamble on a cattle deal, taking on a herd before they have a buyer lined up? Back home in Alabama, Kaley's patience reaches a breaking point as houseguest Andrew tracks in mud and expects a free lunch. To top it off, he then asks if his whole family can crash there while he searches for a permanent residence. Misty finds some extra help with her troublesome barrel-racing horse. Booger and Matthew are on the hunt for the perfect one-year anniversary gift for Jaclyn. But Booger may have a special surprise up his sleeve.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E13
programme.desc: Bret Maverick goes to Hollow Rock, Wyoming to attend the 4th of July horse race. In the town, he gets swindled in a card game by a corrupt sheriff who has him beaten, robbed, and thrown in jail. Bret's forced to enter the race to get his money back.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E13
programme.desc: Cheyenne returns the body of war hero Cole Prescott to his hometown of White River for a proper burial. However, when Cheyenne arrives, instead of a warm welcome, the townspeople greet him with hate towards the dead man.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S05 E01
programme.desc: Cheyenne returns to his hometown as Sheriff Bodie. He is seeking a murderer in a town filled with corruption. Being home brings back many memories, including an old feud and a man who organized a lynching when he was a child.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E28
programme.desc: Clarence Bibs, a simple-minded man, fancies himself as a gunfighter. While practicing, he falls and his gun fires, killing a famous gunslinger. The man's partner comes to town wanting revenge.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E29
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark go on a hunting trip and soon become witnesses to a robbery and murder. Lucas subdues the two robbers, but is severely wounded in the process. Lucas struggles to get the robbers to justice, but devises a plan just in the nick of time.

programme.title: Maverick - S03 E22
programme.desc: Bret Maverick wins a massive sheep herd in a poker game from a rancher named Big Coley. However, the sheep are located on territory in the middle of a violent range war. When the cattlemen want his sheep gone, Bret finds a way to fight back.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S07 E06
programme.desc: Sioux brave White Crow needs medical help for his sick wife, Little Fawn. Cheyenne and Doc Farnsworth leave to go see her. When White Crow returns with gold as payment to heal her, the locals want to invade Sioux territory, possibly starting a war.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E22
programme.desc: Julia Andueza opens a boarding house in North Fork. Lucas remembers her as a dishonest card dealer from the past. Her old boss arrives and tries to bully Julia into turning her business into a gambling house. Lucas realizes she has changed her ways.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E23
programme.desc: Lucas' life is in danger after he agrees to testify in a murder case in another town. The only other witness was killed, and when a gun-toting stranger appears at the McCain Ranch, Lucas now finds himself in grave danger.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E06
programme.desc: Bret Maverick travels to Mexico to find a man wanted for murder, then bring him back to New Orleans. He soon finds the supposed killer, a bartender named Steve Corbett. The two become friends, but only after Bret believes in his innocence.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S02 E11
programme.desc: After a bank robbery, two Pinkerton detectives join forces to track the notorious Missouri Kid. During a shootout, the Missouri Kid kills seasoned detective Charles Schumacher, leaving young George Dougherty to finish the job and avenge his death.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E01
programme.desc: Unable to apprehend the train-robbing Smith Brothers, Sheriff Doc Shores calls the Pinkerton Detective Agency for assistance. The agency sends Charles Siringo, an undercover specialist known for his unorthodox methods of capturing criminals.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E03
programme.desc: As a member of Lewis and Clark's Corps of Discovery, John Colter travels from the Missouri River all the way to the Pacific Ocean, but he decides not to return to the civilized East when the expedition ends. Entranced by the beauty and adventure of the wild frontier, he becomes one of America's first mountain men. As a hunter, trapper and explorer in his own right, he's the first American to see the Grand Tetons and the epic Yellowstone Valley. While his epic explorations make him famous, it's a harrowing ordeal with Blackfeet warriors that makes him a legend. After boldly venturing into territory controlled by the Blackfeet tribe, Colter is captured, stripped naked, and forced to run for his life as warriors give chase in what will come to be known as Colter's Run.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - S05 E05
programme.desc: Bubba, Booger and Cody take an important step toward becoming big-time cattle brokers! The guys are roping and doctoring yearlings on the Texas range. But when Booger's most reliable horse Studly trips, smashing both horse and rider to the ground, Booger must rush out to find a vet and tend to his injured horse. Just as the cowboys are about to leave Texas, a local rancher makes them an offer they can't refuse. Will the guys gamble on a cattle deal, taking on a herd before they have a buyer lined up? Back home in Alabama, Kaley's patience reaches a breaking point as houseguest Andrew tracks in mud and expects a free lunch. To top it off, he then asks if his whole family can crash there while he searches for a permanent residence. Misty finds some extra help with her troublesome barrel-racing horse. Booger and Matthew are on the hunt for the perfect one-year anniversary gift for Jaclyn. But Booger may have a special surprise up his sleeve.

programme.desc: Tom Birch, an old childhood friend, comes to visit Lucas unexpectedly. Birch promises he is just passing through on his way to Denver. But Lucas soon finds out about a plot to rob the North Fork Bank and must choose between friendship and justice.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E26
programme.desc: Just released from prison, Dan Maury comes to North Fork in search of Marshal Micah Torrance, who helped get him locked up. Torrance carries a shotgun everywhere he goes, but Maury plans to wait him out.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E27
programme.desc: A crooked marshal comes to North Fork looking for a wanted man. He finds a man fitting the futitive's description. He deliberately kills the wrong man to collect the bounty and then blackmails the real outlaw, who wants to keep his past hidden.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E02
programme.desc: As U.S. Marshal Bass Reeves attempts to arrest Belle Starr and her outlaw husband, Belle asks for 24 hours to find someone to care for her young daughter, Pearl. When the Starr family decides to flee instead, the Marshal must track them down.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E03
programme.desc: Teenaged fugitive William Bonney is given a second chance when a kindhearted ranch owner offers him a job. But when his new employer is killed in cold blood, Bonney reverts to his criminal ways, seeking vengeance and transforming into Billy the Kid.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E04
programme.desc: With dreams of fortune and adventure, an 18-year-old Jim Bridger joins William Ashley's expedition to trap beaver along the Missouri River. But a grim ordeal soon forces Bridger to weigh his morals against the harsh reality of survival in the wild. A vicious grizzly bear attack leaves fellow trapper and hunter Hugh Glass on the verge of death and completely dependent upon Bridger's care. As a hostile band of Arikara warriors begins to close in, Bridger must choose between staying with the dying man and risking certain death, or leaving his injured comrade alone in the woods and fleeing to safety. In what becomes a legendary tale of the wild frontier, Bridger wrestles to choose between right and wrong, knowing the harsh retribution that will follow if he makes the wrong choice.

programme.title: Maverick - S01 E05
programme.desc: A dying outlaw named Lefty Dolan asks Bret Maverick to clear a man who was wrongly convicted of bank robbery. Maverick embarks on a year-long quest across the Wyoming and Arizona territories to find Jedd Ferris and clear him of the crime.

programme.desc: Bart Maverick and Gentleman Jack Darby team up with an exotic Spanish dancer named Elena Grande to win a flooded mine from its crooked owner, John Wilson. Their scheme involves a staged fight and the fake murder of Darby.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Viva el domingo
programme.desc: Ludovico planea un domingo maravilloso de botanas y fútbol, olvidando que tenía que ir a casa de sus suegros. Descubre cómo Ludovico intenta regresar a casa lo más pronto posible para ver el partido de su equipo favorito.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Encuentro casual
programme.desc: Federica se encuentra con su amiga Columba y las indirectas entre ellas no se hacen esperar. Federica quiere vengarse de que Columba y Bacilio les ganaron en el dominó. Los P. Luche le organizan una fiesta de despedida a Columba y su esposo.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - El que se fue a la Villa
programme.desc: El departamento se siente vacío sin Fran, pero una indiscreta necesidad hará que Borrego consiga asilo temporal en esta casa, siempre y cuando cumpla con las condiciones de Toña y Paco.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Chío paracaidista
programme.desc: Rocío llega al departamento de Paco con sus cosas, pues considera prudente pasar una temporada ahí al no estar Fran y no haber recibido la pensión que le corresponde. Pero se llevará una gran sorpresa cuando vea que el cuarto de su hijo ya está ocupado.

programme.title: Vecinos - La verdad de Luis y Pedro
programme.desc: Los vecinos creen que Luis corrió a Pedro de su casa y todos lo tratan mal, Pedro decide irse a vivir con Germán. Don Roque le pide a Frankie que le ayude a escribir las memorias de su vida.

programme.title: Vecinos - Embargo a los pobres ricos
programme.desc: Arturo no puede pagar una deuda con el banco y van a embargarlos, Magda no puede soportar que les quiten sus cosas y hace todo lo posible por evitarlo.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - Se busca un héroe

programme.desc: Martina encuentra trabajo y se siente más independiente. Mientras que La Nena y Aldolfo tratarán de convencer a Licha de irse de vacaciones a Acapulco.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Lucha interna parte 2

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Que pedí yo

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 4
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano empiezan a trabajar en un asilo de ancianos y tratan de ocultar la muerte de uno de los viejitos.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 5
programme.desc: Albertano y Vítor realizan un servicio de mudanza pero todo se les complica cuando su camioneta desaparece.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 6
programme.desc: Las clases de yoga de Albertano son un éxito y Silvia, una de sus alumnas, le pide que le dé clases particulares. Albertano y Silvia se vuelven amantes y él descubre que es esposa del procurador.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 7
programme.desc: Albertano y Vítor parecen haber encontrado el amor y ambos consiguen novia al mismo tiempo, un giro del destino pondrá en peligro su amistad al descubrir que comparten a la misma novia.

programme.title: Vecinos - Una pareja real
programme.desc: La amiga de Silvita, se queda en el departamento de los recién casados, ya que se ha quedado sin casa ¿Qué hará Luis para que Ari se vaya pronto? Además, Magda trata de convencer a los vecinos, para que acepten poner un anuncio en la fachada del edificio.

programme.title: Vecinos - El nuevo reglamento
programme.desc: Los Rivers sólo tienen dinero para comer atún, así que Frankie envía a Benito a hacer el casting para interpretar al Sol. Pero Luis propone realizar un nuevo reglamento de convivencia vecinal.

programme.title: Vecinos - La historia de Jorjáis
programme.desc: Jorjáis cuenta su verdadera historia y hará llorar a más de uno. ¡No te pierdas ningún detalle! Además, como Frankie y Lorena no están en casa, Benito y Liz aprovecharán para hacer algo en su ausencia.

programme.title: Vecinos - La cocina económica
programme.desc: Jorjáis deja su sillón en la entrada del edificio y en un momento de descuido, desaparece. Además, Lorena abre una cocina económica ¿Algún vecino se verá afectado con su instalación?

programme.title: Vecinos - Una pareja real
programme.desc: Los Rivers abren la correspondencia de los López Pérez y se enteran de que les embargarán la lavadora. ¿Magdalena se atreverá a demandarlos? Silvita y Pedro jugarán con Cris y Pedro para saber quiénes son una pareja real.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - La sirvienta
programme.desc: Federica convence a Ludovico de que le contrate una sirvienta. Federica se aferra a contratar a una mujer conservadora y gruñona, mientras que Ludovico pretende quedarse con una mujer de buen cuerpo aunque algo torpe.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - El cumpleaños de Ludoviquito

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Las cenizas
programme.desc: Severino quiere que Ludovico cuide de sus cenizas por dos días para convertirse en su heredero universal.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - El primo de oro
programme.desc: Un hombre rico dice ser primo de la familia pero ni Ludovico ni Federica lo recuerdan. Él promete dejarles una gran herencia, pero por un error, pierden el dinero.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Una novia para Don Camerino
programme.desc: Ludovico piensa que Don Camerino busca una esposa y por ello le presenta a Lucrecia, su cuñada solterona.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Ludovico in the school
programme.desc: Ludovico se enfrenta a varias dificultades cuando tiene que regresar a la escuela para obtener su certificado de primaria.

programme.desc: María va a un centro nocturno con sus amigas pero sus acompañantes las dejan con la cuenta.

programme.desc: Rosa le consigue trabajo a Albertano presentando Placentex Antiesponge. Doña Lucha se pone muy celosa porque María le plancha la ropa a Albertano.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Domingo en Chapultepec
programme.desc: Albertano y María pasan una tarde romántica hasta que recuerdan que tenían que cuidar al Chino.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - La noche de la langosta
programme.desc: María quiere tener una cena romántica con Albertano pero los vecinos no los dejan porque quieren ver la final del fútbol.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - El rap de Doña Juana
programme.desc: El gato de Doña Juana parece estar muerto y Doña Lucha tiene que darle la triste noticia.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - Ahí va el agua
programme.desc: La familia López es notificada de que se les cortará el servicio del agua en su departamento. Los miembros de la familia intentan averiguar quién es el responsable de que les hayan retirado el servicio del agua.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - Tome su turno
programme.desc: Plácido expresa ante su familia su sentir acerca de la falta de intimidad que existe en su hogar. La nueva dinámica para poder vivir en casa de los López es aportar dinero, de lo contrario deben tomar su turno para poder residir ahí.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - El embarazo no deseado
programme.desc: La familia López se reúne con Tecla para que confiese la verdad sobre su embarazo. Tecla admite que lo hizo porque le gustó y reitera que lo volvería hacer. Tecla confiesa que fue con Aldolfo y que fueron tres veces.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - El socio
programme.desc: Plácido se preocupa por una llamada de Don Justo y le expresa a su familia que tendrá una reunión con su jefe. Don Justo va nombrar socio a quien le tenga su café caliente.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - ¿Quién se comió los tamales?
programme.desc: En el departamento de la familia López se va la luz y comienzan a suceder cosas extrañas. Tecla es confundida con un fantasma, Don Arnoldo se da cuenta que mientras se fue la luz, han desaparecido sus tamales.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - Las vacaciones
programme.desc: Plácido y Plutarco se muestran muy contentos ante su familia y explican que Don Justo les ha dado sus primeras vacaciones pagadas. La familia López se organiza para salir juntos de paseo a Pepetongo.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Pacosterona
programme.desc: Paco tiene una falla en la intimidad con Simone, así que Betochas le recomienda una uróloga de primera. Mira lo que sucederá cuando vea a la bella doctora y esta le pase el seguimiento a un doctor de su confianza.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Tulum, tenemos un problema
programme.desc: Mientras Simone se va a Riviera Maya, Paco la estoquea en redes sociales. Mira lo que pasará cuando vea que la está pasando muy bien en compañía de algunos galanes.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - El candidato de Toña
programme.desc: Macedonio empieza a coquetear con Toña, pues se ha lanzado como candidato en la alcaldía. Así que Brayan Danielle acudirá a Paco y al Borrego para evitar este romance. Mira todos los trapos sucios que encontrarán sobre el candidato.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Vota por mulata
programme.desc: Macedonio toma represalias obligando a Paco y el Borrego a negociar una tregua. Escucha de qué se trata y si votarán por él en las elecciones.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Tattoo por amor
programme.desc: Paco y Brayan están deprimidos por la ruptura de sus relaciones, pero con la ayuda del Borrego, intentarán recuperarlas. Ve, si con sus consejos lograrán el perdón de sus exparejas o habrá sido peor el remedio que el problema.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Tatuados sin gloria
programme.desc: Paco quiere borrarse el tatuaje de Simone y encuentra un grupo que lo podrá ayudar, ahí mismo conoce a Mila a quien intentará ligarse, pero debe confesarse. ¿Logrará Mila convencer a Paco de dejarse su tattoo o se lo quitará para siempre?

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - Se busca un héroe
programme.desc: La banda firma un contrato con altos ejecutivos de Televisa para hacer un reality de talento, Zacarias se entera y amenaza con demandarlos. Prisca denuncia a Hassan, la policía lo encarcela.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - La novia de Ludoviquito
programme.desc: Ludoviquito lleva a su novia a casa para presentarle a su familia, pero después terminan y su familia cree que se quiere suicidar.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Brad Pittin
programme.desc: Federica se reencuentra con su ex novio de la prepa, Nazario, alias Brad Pittin. Al ver que es un hombre rico y exitoso, Federica decide pasar más tiempo con él.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Video estúpido
programme.desc: Ludoviquito quiere entrar a un concurso de los videos más estúpidos de la gente y sin querer se lleva un video comprometedor de sus papás.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - El concurso de reclamos
programme.desc: Ludovico insiste en que su cuñada Lucrecia entre al concurso de reclamos que Federica ganó el año anterior, pero Don Camerino lo obliga a que Federica participe de nuevo.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Celosa, patética y desconfiada
programme.desc: Federica asiste a un seminario en un convento para controlar sus celos. Don Camerino le pide a Ludovico que lleve a su sobrina Leonarda al convento porque tiene problemas de alcohol.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Regalo de aniversario
programme.desc: Ludovico tiene que conseguir un regalo de aniversario para Federica antes de la cena para no dormir a oscuras en una tina.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Dulces recuerdos
programme.desc: Con mucho espíritu navideño, Federica y Ludovico presentan algunos bloopers que pasan durante las grabaciones.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Federica desaparece
programme.desc: Un mago desparece a Federica y la manda al desierto, donde los árabes la tratan como esclava. Ludovico está muy feliz por su libertad, aunque comienza a provocar problemas en la casa.

programme.title: Vecinos - La bocinota
programme.desc: Vanessa es la nueva representante vecinal y su primera decisión es aceptar tener como vecino un nuevo negocio que escandaliza con unas enormes bocinas. ¿Podrá ponerle un alto?

programme.title: Vecinos - Bienvenido doctor
programme.desc: El doctor Rafael Rivas se mudó al edificio y Magdalena no dejará pasar la oportunidad para conseguir una consulta gratis. ¿Crees que acepte? Acompáñanos a ver cómo será el nuevo inquilino.

programme.title: Vecinos - Una de terror
programme.desc: Silvita trata de mantener limpios los pasillos del edificio, ya que Lorena y Magdalena sacaron todas sus macetas. Mientras Luis trabaja, Pedro y Cris verán una película ¿Podrá concentrarse o se asustará más que ellos?

programme.title: Vecinos - Matrimonio perfecto
programme.desc: Silvita le demostrará a su vieja amiga Caro que tiene un matrimonio perfecto con Luis. Además, Lorena culpa a Germán por no tener limpio el patio del edificio ¿Quién saboteará el arduo trabajo del conserje?

programme.title: Vecinos - Roof garden
programme.desc: Frankie abre un canal de videos para hablar sobre todo lo que sabe de cine. Mientras tanto, Magdalena quiere tener un departamento con roof garden. Ve si logrará ponerlo en el edificio.

programme.title: Vecinos - Megacorte de agua
programme.desc: Magdalena se gastará el bono de Arturo en la compra de su tan anhelado aire acondicionado. Mientras tanto, se anuncia un megacorte de agua que durará una semana ¿Los vecinos serán responsables con el uso de este líquido vital?

programme.title: Una familia de diez - El abuelo pierde la memoria
programme.desc: Don Arnoldo, mientras duerme, menciona que tiene un tesoro en el pueblo de Apaseo el Grande, Guanajuato. La familia López implementa un plan para la búsqueda del tesoro.

programme.title: Amores con Trampa Capítulo 52
programme.desc: Isabel le dice a Facundo que si se va a un spa con ella por solo una noche, lo dejará en paz. Facundo le dice a María que se irá a un viaje de negocios para estar con Isabel. Santiago le suplica a Isabel que no lo engañe con Facundo.

programme.title: Qué Bonito Amor Capítulo 144
programme.desc: Bruno y Elvira llevan a cabo sus planes para deshacerse de María y de su negocio. Santos comienza un plan de escape para huir de prisión, pero las cosas se le complican.

programme.title: Pasión y poder Capítulo 32
programme.desc: Arturo le confiesa a Agustín que Julia aún lo ama y Nina alcanza a escuchar lo que está sucediendo. ¿Cuál será su reacción? Nina descubre a Monserrat en la habitación de Erick y le advierte que nunca podrá ser una Montenegro.

programme.title: Mañana Es Para Siempre Capítulo 148
programme.desc: Fernanda se sorprende al saber que Erika decidió adelantar la fecha de su boda. Gonzalo se molesta al saber que por culpa de Fernanda, Camilo está encarcelado. Venus se alegra al saber que el estado de salud de Steve ha mejorado.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 32
programme.desc: Melesio comete una indiscreción con Fátima al comentarle sobre la boda de su sobrino. Fátima continúa haciéndole la vida complicada a Esmeralda. José Armando y el Dr. Álvaro hablan de la operación de Esmeralda y de un asunto importante.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 21
programme.desc: Mario se acerca a Jimena para contarle que Ricardo es espía del rey. Ricardo le confiesa a Jimena que se está enamorando de ella. Lisabeta quiere ir a la posada para buscar a Ricardo.

programme.title: Mañana Es Para Siempre Capítulo 149
programme.desc: Bárbara convence a Gonzalo de no ayudar a Camilo a salir de la cárcel. Santiago se molesta al saber que Camilo abusó de Aurora. Gardenia le cuenta a Erika que Eduardo está enamorado de Fernanda.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 33
programme.desc: Rodolfo corre a Esmeralda de la casa y la lleva con Lucio para que se haga cargo de ella. Lucio le confiesa a Esmeralda sus verdaderos sentimientos hacia ella. Crisanta, ante la injusticia, revela una verdad impactante.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 22
programme.desc: Doña Camila queda fascinada con el beso de Don Ricardo. Ofelia le dice a Rita que está embarazada después de que siente un dolor en el abdomen. Doña Lisabeta tiene la esperanza de que Don Ricardo algún día se case con ella.

programme.title: Tres Veces Ana Capítulo 63
