programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 2
programme.desc: La batalla entre los seis escuadrones da inicio y cada punto será vital para salvarse de la sentencia. Los pequeños demostrarán su talento a través de su carisma, su voz, sus pasos de baile y sus increíbles habilidades en Cuatro Elementitos.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 3
programme.desc: Uno de los seis escuadrones dice adiós y antes de irse, Tadeo le hace una petición especial a los jueces. Los capitanes cuentan sus historias de vida de una manera muy peculiar. Los pequeños bailarines muestran sus mejores pasos en una prueba individual.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 4
programme.desc: Grandes estrellas de la música acompañan a los pequeños en el reto de canto. La bailarina argentina, Laurita Fernández, se une como jueza invitada para calificar los retos de baile. Los capitanes rinden homenaje a Verónica Castro.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 5
programme.desc: Es noche de sentencia y los cinco escuadrones darán lo mejor en el escenario. María León se une como invitada al panel de jueces. Los capitanes se enfrentan al reto de ‘Gali Dice’ para ganar un punto extra. Albertano le da una sorpresa a todos los jueces.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 6
programme.desc: Es noche de eliminación y uno de los escuadrones deja la competencia. Los pequeños cumplen el reto de canto de Miguel Bosé con sorprendentes resultados. Los capitanes se enfrentan al reto del ‘Botonera’.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 7
programme.desc: La competencia entra en su recta final y cada prueba será decisiva para los escuadrones. Yuri se une como juez invitada. Los capitanes comparten una parte de su vida con el público. Verónica Castro recibe una sorpresa de parte de su nieta.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 8
programme.desc: Los pequeños reciben como invitada especial a Lucero. Albertano pone a prueba la honestidad de los capitanes. Las parejas tendrán que demostrar sus habilidades en una prueba de baile improvisado.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 9
programme.desc: Los pequeños llegan a la semifinal y uno de los tres escuadrones sentenciados será eliminado. Prince Royce canta a lado de los pequeños sus mejores éxitos. Los capitanes pasan un día especial junto con los jueces.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 10
programme.desc: Después de diez semanas donde los momentos de diversión, alegría y emoción se hicieron presentes, los pequeños viven el último programa de la competencia con un gran performance al lado de grandes artistas como Paulina Rubio.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 1
programme.desc: Biby Gaytán, María León, Albertano y Juanpa Zurita se unen a la nueva temporada de Pequeños Gigantes y tendrán la tarea de seleccionar a los pequeños competidores. Los escuadrones quedan atrás y la competencia se vuelve individual.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 2
programme.desc: Los jueces se dan a la tarea de seleccionar a los últimos participantes de ‘Pequeños Gigantes’. Los aspirantes se enfrentan en una serie de duelos donde tendrán que demostrar sus cualidades de canto y baile.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 3
programme.desc: Los pequeños tendrán que dar su mejor esfuerzo y demostrar su talento en el escenario, ya que cuatro cantantes, junto con cuatro bailarinas serán eliminados en el primer duelo de la competencia.

programme.desc: Disfruta de ‘La Banda el Recodo’ acompañando a los ‘Pequeños Gigantes’.

programme.desc: Grandes invitados juegan con los pequeños y un escuadrón es eliminado.

programme.desc: Los ‘Pequeños Gigantes’ preparan grandes sorpresas para Galilea y Gloria Trevi.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 14

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes 2 Programa 1
programme.desc: Galilea presenta a su hijo y los jueces seleccionan a los participantes de los 7 equipos.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes 2 Programa 2
programme.desc: La competencia comienza y los equipos son formados. Galilea presenta al niño que ha sido el primer lugar en la tabla de posiciones.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes 2 Programa 3
programme.desc: Los pequeños cantan con estrellas invitadas. Tres equipos son sentenciados y Toñito revela su rostro.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes 2 Programa 4
programme.desc: Los pequeños cantan a dúo con Yuri y Noel. Un escuadrón se despide de sus compañeros.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes 2 Programa 5
programme.desc: Los capitanes de cada equipo cuentan su vida mediante un libro hecho por ellos. Los cantantes de los diferentes equipos se enfrentan.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes 2 Programa 6
programme.desc: Recapitulación especial de los primeros cinco episodios. Las mejores presentaciones se hacen presentes en este especial.

programme.desc: Los jueces imitan a otros artistas y los pequeños cantan a dúo con ellos.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes 2 Programa 8
programme.desc: Los equipos cantan a dúo con Bianca, María José, Fanny Lu y Edith Márquez. Rogelio, el capitán de ‘Mega Estrellas’, personifica a Jo-Jo-Jorgito Falcón.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes 2 Programa 9
programme.desc: Los bailarines de cada escuadrón hacen espectaculares bailes junto a Bianca, María José y Raquel. El cantante de cada equipo le canta emotivamente a un ser querido.

programme.desc: Los Irresistibles son el primer escuadrón en pasar a la semifinal. El grupo Megabait presenta su primer video musical.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes 2 Programa 11
programme.desc: La semifinal ha iniciado y grandes artistas engalanan la noche. Los jueces deciden quiénes son los escuadrones que llegan a la gran final. Mega Estrellas, Super Poderosos y Super Peques, hoy uno de ellos se despide de la competencia.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes 2 Programa 12
programme.desc: Hoy es una noche especial, la gran final de Pequeños Gigantes ha llegado. Iniciaron siete escuadrones y sólo tres llegan a la final. Sonrisas, lágrimas y todo el talento de niños extraordinarios pero hoy solo un escuadrón será el ganador del gran trofeo.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 1
programme.desc: El espectacular programa ha comenzado y los pequeños grandes talentos se hicieron presentes en el escenario para conformar los seis escuadrones que competirán cada semana para alcanzar su sueño.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 2
programme.desc: La espectacular competencia arranca y los seis talentosos escuadrones comienzan la lucha por alcanzar sus sueños. Los capitales se enfrentan en una divertida prueba de imitación.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 3
programme.desc: Varios talentos de las temporadas anteriores de 'Pequeños Gigantes' regresan para unirse a los participantes y ayudarles en su prueba de canto. Se vive la primera eliminación del programa. Yuridia se presenta en el escenario.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 4
programme.desc: El grupo Bronco llega al escenario de ‘Pequeños Gigantes’ para cantar sus grandes éxitos. Los ‘Pequeños Gigantes’ realizan espectaculares actuaciones en la pista de baile.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 5
programme.desc: Los pequeños bailarines se enfrentan en una prueba de mambo. El cantante Christian Nodal se presenta en el escenario de ‘Pequeños Gigantes’. Albertano sorprende en el programa cantando ‘Despacito’.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 6
programme.desc: La cantante internacional Filippa Giordano se presenta en el escenario de Pequeños Gigantes. Los capitanes se enfrentan en una prueba de preguntas y respuestas. Se vive la segunda eliminación de la competencia.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 7
programme.desc: El cantante Flex se presenta en el escenario de Pequeños Gigantes. Los bailarines se enfrentan con ritmos de cumbia y merengue. Los capitanes concursan con los jueces en pruebas de habilidad y destreza.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 8
programme.desc: El cantante Ricardo Montaner se presenta en el escenario. Los capitanes se convierten en actores y compiten por un Oscarito. Se vive la última sentencia, dos escuadrones quedan en riesgo de eliminación perdiendo la oportunidad de llegar a la gran final.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 9
programme.desc: Alicia Villarreal, Lucero y La Sonora Dinamita se presentan en el escenario. Los capitanes se enfrentan en divertidos retos en ‘4 elementitos’. Los equipos viven la última eliminación y tres escuadrones llegan a la gran final.

programme.desc: Los Pequeños Gigantes viven el último programa de la competencia al lado de grandes artistas como Carlos Rivera, Ha-Ash y Espinoza Paz, quienes se presentan en el escenario para cantar junto a los finalistas y conocer a los ganadores.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Las apariencias engañan'
programme.desc: Un señor es contratado para ser chofer de un camión de eventos sociales, pero su jefe lo usa para transportar a jóvenes que vende como trata de blancas y su hija resulta ser una de ellas.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'De tal palo, tal astilla'
programme.desc: Un padre de familia golpea a su esposa e hija, la joven planea huir con su novio, pero el hermano de la chica regresa, él denuncia a su padre para que lo detengan y ella no se va.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Haz el bien'
programme.desc: Un indigente es apedreado por unos niños, un señor lo ayuda, lo lleva al hospital y le avisa a su familia para que vayan a buscarlo. El indigente se recupera y le regala su carro al señor para agradecerle.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que con lobos se junta'
programme.desc: Un grupo de jóvenes roban en el 'Café El Dicho' y el más pequeño se encuentra con un famoso luchador, quien le cuenta que tiene una historia muy similar, y le platica sobre la muerte de su mamá.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Las mentiras tienen las piernas cortas Parte 2'
programme.desc: Poncho, el mesero del café 'El Dicho', encuentra una foto de su mamá con un hombre y él cree que es su papá. Poncho comprende las razones por las que su mamá nunca le dijo la verdad y se reconcilia con ella.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Ten cuidado con lo que deseas'
programme.desc: Una chica trata de escapar de su casa para salir con su novio, pero su hermana grita y les avisa a sus padres para que lo eviten. El padre hace hasta lo imposible para que su hija deje de verse con su novio.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que siembra vientos cosecha tempestades'
programme.desc: Una joven se escapa de su casa después de que su papá intenta abusar de ella, la chica va a casa de uno de sus amigos y le cuenta lo que pasó. El joven y sus amigos abusan de ella.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'No por miedo a fallar'
programme.desc: Una señora le pide a su hija que se vaya de la casa porque su patrona cree que ella le robó dinero. Cuando la chica va a su casa un hombre la secuestra, la lleva a una casa y trata de prostituirla.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Diablo te hiciste'
programme.desc: Miriam, es una adolescente que por falta de atención de sus padres, cae en una broma pesada por internet. El padre de Miriam es aficionado a ver páginas en internet de adolescentes y encuentra las fotos de su hija en una página prohibida.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Al que no habla'
programme.desc: Una chica va caminando con un amigo de la escuela de regreso a su casa, cuando el novio de su mamá los encuentra en la calle y amenaza al chico para que se aleje de ella. Cuando llegan al departamento, el novio de la mamá intenta manosear a la chica.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que quiere la flor'
programme.desc: Una joven embarazada es abandonada por el padre de su hijo, su mejor amigo la consuela. Los amigos del ex novio lo golpean. La joven le confiesa que está embarazada y él le dice que la apoya para que se deshaga del niño.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - ‘El que tiene más saliva’
programme.desc: Una chica que es integrante de una banda se pelea con el vocalista porque sabe que es una mala persona, pero una de sus amigas lo defiende y comienza a tratarla mal hasta que ella decide dejar la banda.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Agua que no has de beber'

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Lo que no fue en tu año'
programme.desc: Un hombre recién casado comienza a desconfiar de su esposa, pues descubre que no le dijo su verdadero nombre. El hombre le pide ayuda a un amigo para investigar a su mujer, ella finalmente le cuenta la verdad.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Fue sin querer queriendo'
programme.desc: Poncho se queda dormido en la cafetería. En sus sueños se vuelve el “Poncholín colorado” y el “Poncho del ocho” haciendo homenaje a los personajes, situaciones y formas cómicas del famoso autor.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El amor que se hace nudo'
programme.desc: Un joven festeja su despedida de soltero con sus amigos y termina en casa de una chava que conoció en el bar. El joven les cuenta a sus amigos que la chava lo acosa y agrede a su novia. El joven le confiesa a su novia lo que pasó y ella termina con él.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Donde hubo fuego'
programme.desc: Rogelio, un hombre comprometido con su novia, se reencuentra con Susana, su primer amor. Después de dudar y estar en una incertidumbre, se ve con Nadia y platican sobre el añorado primer amor que vivieron, dejando en claro sus sentimientos.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que nace pa’ maceta'
programme.desc: Un joven que sufre de sordera es maltratado por sus compañeros de la escuela y su familia. El chico vive con sus tíos, su tía lo odia y le exige a su esposo correrlo de la casa. La maestra del chico y una niña tratan de ayudarlo.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El valiente vive, hasta que el cobarde quiere'
programme.desc: Un joven es abusivo con sus compañeros de la escuela golpeándolos y quitándoles todo su dinero. El joven, su madre y hermano son maltratados por su padre lo que provoca que el chico sea tan agresivo.

programme.title: Como Dice El Dicho - ‘Ojos que no ven’
programme.desc: Lucía es una chica que descubre la infidelidad de su novio. Lucía tiene una infección en los ojos y su madre compra un medicamento económico que le provoca ceguera. La joven culpa a su mamá de su desgracia, pero pronto su vida cambiará.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'No todo lo que brilla es oro'
programme.desc: Una joven cantante que vive noches de fiesta todos los días conoce a un hombre, se enamora y le pide que sea su nuevo representante. Él la mete al mundo de las drogas arruinando su vida y la de su familia.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Contigo la milpa es rancho'
programme.desc: Un joven regresa a su pueblo y se entera que su padre ha muerto. El chico amenaza a un hombre cuando descubre que quiere abusar de su novia. El hombre mata a la madre del chico para quedarse con sus tierras.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El momento más oscuro'
programme.desc: Una jovencita es golpeada por su padre, y para proteger a su madre, no se queja de nada. La mamá de la niña se la pasa tomando pastillas para dormir y descuida a su hija. La maestra se da cuenta de que es maltratada por sus padres.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Aunque la jaula sea de oro'
programme.desc: Karina se casa con Luis perdidamente enamorada, sin saber que es un celópata, con el paso del tiempo se entera que, Sofía, su ex mujer, se suicidó por culpa de la enfermedad de su marido y le pide a la servidumbre que la ayude a escapar.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'No tiene la culpa el indio'
programme.desc: Un señor sufre un accidente en una construcción. Un joven que trabaja en la construcción queda impactado con el accidente de uno de sus compañeros. La hermana del joven sufre de bullying por ser indígena.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que esté libre de culpa'
programme.desc: Una joven se embaraza del novio de su mejor amiga, la chica oculta la identidad del padre de su hijo. Durante su embarazo la chica les dice a sus amigas que no quiere a su hijo y desea que el bebé nazca sin vida.

programme.title: Como Dice El Dicho - 'Nada mejor en la vida'
programme.desc: Liz se embaraza de Saúl, su novio, pero no quiere hacerse responsable. Liz tiene un padre autoritario al cual no le tiene confianza pero sin querer, se entera que su hija está embarazada. Él les obliga a casarse pero todo es un fracaso.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Caras vemos'
programme.desc: Una joven que es muy celosa golpea a una chica y le prohíbe hablarle a su novio. Un día la chica y su novio terminan y él le confiesa que está enamorado de otra chica. La joven le pide al chico que vaya a su casa y lo secuestra.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho - 'Dios aprieta pero no ahorca'
programme.desc: Una joven vive con su abuela, pero la señora la trata muy mal porque ella es hija de la sirvienta. El hijo de la señora pierde su casa en un juego y le pide a su madre que deje que él y su familia vivan con ella.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Contigo la milpa es rancho'
programme.desc: Un joven regresa a su pueblo y se entera que su padre ha muerto. El chico amenaza a un hombre cuando descubre que quiere abusar de su novia. El hombre mata a la madre del chico para quedarse con sus tierras.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El momento más oscuro'
programme.desc: Una jovencita es golpeada por su padre, y para proteger a su madre, no se queja de nada. La mamá de la niña se la pasa tomando pastillas para dormir y descuida a su hija. La maestra se da cuenta de que es maltratada por sus padres.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Aunque la jaula sea de oro'
programme.desc: Karina se casa con Luis perdidamente enamorada, sin saber que es un celópata, con el paso del tiempo se entera que, Sofía, su ex mujer, se suicidó por culpa de la enfermedad de su marido y le pide a la servidumbre que la ayude a escapar.

programme.title: Como Dice El Dicho - 'En casa del ladrón'
programme.desc: Una joven está obsesionada con la muerte de su padre, cree que él quiere comunicarse con ella para darle un mensaje. La joven cree que el mejor amigo de su papá y su mamá son amantes, y que ellos tuvieron que ver con la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Cara de beato'
programme.desc: Un joven debe dinero de drogas y decide irse a vivir con sus tíos a otra ciudad para escapar, pero lo siguen para cobrarle todo el dinero que debe. El joven se roba la tarjeta de su tía y saca el dinero.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'A cada uno le toca escoger'
programme.desc: Poncho es un jovencito que decide irse a vivir a la calle, pues los maltratos del esposo de su abuela son insoportables. Un día conoce a dos señoras que se dedican a la explotación de menores, obligándolos a robar.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Candil de la calle'
programme.desc: Dulce comienza a beber porque en su casa tiene muchos problemas, un día la chica se droga y la llevan al hospital, pero ella sigue bebiendo. Sus padres la ayudan y deciden tomar terapia familiar.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'La Mentira Dura'
programme.desc: Una joven graba videos maltratando a la gente para subirlos a la red. La mejor amiga de la joven se preocupa al saber que subir videos le ha traído algunos problemas en el colegio.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - ‘La unión hace la fuerza’
programme.desc: Una mujer que se hace pasar por trabajadora social se lleva a una niña a una casa hogar después de que sus padres fueran encarcelados por robar. La señora planea vender a la niña a una pareja que no puede tener hijos.

programme.title: Como Dice El Dicho – 'Cuando el tecolote canta'
programme.desc: Refugio insiste en hacerle creer a Ángel que la vida de uno de sus seres queridos corre peligro, después de escuchar al tecolote cantar. Más tarde, El señor sufre un accidente automovilístico y trata de llegar a su casa, pero se encuentra muy mal herido.

programme.title: Como Dice El Dicho - 'Dime de qué presumes'
programme.desc: Diana es una chica que se lastima a sí misma para llamar la atención y sentir un alivio ante los problemas que existen en su casa. Diana se enamora de Adrián, un nuevo compañero de la escuela pero provoca los celos de Rebeca, su mejor amiga.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - ‘Quien mucho amenaza’
programme.desc: Una joven tiene que enfrentar el intento de suicidio de su madre provocado por el alcoholismo y el desamor de su ex marido. La joven trata de complacer a su madre en todo para que no sufra más.

programme.title: Como Dice El Dicho - 'El hombre es fuego, la mujer estopa'
programme.desc: Don José es el párroco de la iglesia, cuando regresa de un mandado, se quita su hábito pues hace mucho calor. Un joven le ofrece bolearle los zapatos, pero es una trampa para asaltarlo, lo golpea y al desmayarse pierde la memoria.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Nada en exceso'
programme.desc: Un hombre que se rehúsa a dejar de comer en exceso sufre un desmayo por comer mucha grasa. A pesar de que su esposa le pide que coma sanamente, su madre lo defiende. El hombre decide ir al nutriólogo para llevar una vida más saludable.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Nadie sabe lo que tiene'
programme.desc: Un joven se aprovecha de su novia porque está muy enamorada de él. Ella le hace todos los trabajos de la escuela, mientras él la engaña con otras chicas de la universidad.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Al que Dios no le da hijos'
programme.desc: Un hombre se dedica a seducir mujeres al por mayor sin ninguna clase de remordimiento, sin embargo pierde la vida en un accidente. Al morir, su hermano Víctor quien jamás pensó en tener hijos decide hacerse cargo de sus sobrinas.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Nadie escarmienta en cabeza ajena'
programme.desc: Una joven trabaja en una clínica donde hacen cirugías plásticas y se enamora del médico, pero cree que él no se fijará en ella por no ser delgada y comienza a dejar de comer, pero reacciona al ver que su amiga fallece por padecer anorexia.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'No dejes para mañana'
programme.desc: Un niño se orina en sus pantalones y sus padres tienen que cambiarlo de escuela. El niño descubre que el compañero de clase que lo hostiga con saña brutal también padece de ‘Enuresis’.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Del agua mansa’
programme.desc: Una joven se obsesiona con su profesor y trata de tener una relación con él, pero él la rechaza. La chica hace unas pruebas falsas para que todos crean que él trató de seducirla. La joven le cuenta a un amigo que el profesor la ha estado acosando.

programme.title: María Candelaria
programme.desc: María Candelaria y Lorenzo Rafael quieren casarse pero no tienen dinero. Un día ella enferma y él roba la medicina para curarla. Lorenzo Rafael va a dar a la cárcel y María Candelaria muere apedreada porque la gente piensa que posó desnuda para un pintor.

programme.title: Los olvidados
programme.desc: Un grupo de delincuentes juveniles vive una vida violenta y llena de crímenes en los barrios marginales de la ciudad de México, y la moral del joven Pedro es gradualmente corrompida y destruida por los demás.

programme.title: Los Novios de Mis Hijas
programme.desc: Una madre viuda vive todo tipo de enredos, angustias y momentos cómicos con sus cuatro hijas, quienes comienzan a sentir interés por enamorarse. Las jóvenes y el serio ahijado de su padre aprenderán a no juzgar de más a los chicos que las cortejan.

programme.title: Camino del infierno
programme.desc: Leticia le pide a León, su amante, robar el dinero a su esposo y huir. Pedro Uribe, excompañero de celda de León, lleva a cabo el robo, pero después la vida de Leticia y Pedro toma un rumbo inesperado.

programme.title: Flor Silvestre
programme.desc: La historia cuenta el gran amor entre Esperanza, nieta de un trabajador, y José Luis Castro, el hijo de un terrateniente de té. Cuando José Luis se une al movimiento revolucionario, es repudiado por su padre pero Esperanza lo sostiene con su amor.

programme.title: Autumn Night, Sound of Light: Muju Anseong Nakhwa Play <16>
programme.desc: Muju Anseong Nakhwa Play is named because the sparks falling along the line resemble flowers and is designated as an intangible cultural heritage traditional play.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Art of Steel: Ornamental Knife Making Master <67>
programme.desc: Small in size, yet rich in meaning—ornamental knives once symbolized both elegance and status. Through intricate forging and decorative detail, these steel blades carry the strength and refinement of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Striking the Jing: Brassware Master <68>
programme.desc: With thousands of hammer strikes, the jing emerges—not just as an instrument, but as a deep, resonant voice of tradition. Made from molten copper and tin, it is shaped and tuned through breath and rhythm passed down for generations.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Legacy of Joseon Ceramics: Porcelain Master <23>
programme.desc: The Baeksan family is a traditional prestigious family that has continued Korean ceramics for over 300 years since the era of King Yeongjo of Joseon Dynasty, greatly supported by the efforts of son Kim Kyung-sik, and grandson Kim Ji-Hoon.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Unwavering Focus: The Horsehair Headband Making Master <91>
programme.desc: Made by meticulously weaving fine strands of horsehair, the manggeon was a refined headpiece worn by men in the Joseon era. Each knot reflects the artisan’s steady hand and quiet discipline. Experience the silent intensity behind this delicate craft.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Masterpieces Created by Time: Ink (Meok) <51>
programme.desc: Ink (Meok) has been one of the Four Treasures of the Study (ink, paper, brush, inkstone) and a companion of scholars since ancient times. Welcome to the world of ink, masterpieces created by time(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Embodying Wishes in Paper: Jihwa Master <43>
programme.desc: Jihwa has been used not only in the royal court but also in family celebrations, Buddhist ceremonies, and shamanic rituals since ancient times. A Jihwa master is an artisan who cuts and decorates paper to create adornments for ceremonies.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Making Ink with Soot: Ink Master <36>
programme.desc: Ink, one of the Four Treasures of the Study (ink, paper, brush, inkstone), has been a companion of scholars since ancient times. Welcome to the world of the ink master.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret of Hanji that Lasts a Thousand Years: Stripping Mulberry Bark <54>
programme.desc: Traditional Hanji possesses excellent value, enduring for a thousand years without changing. Let’s appreciate the process of stripping the bark from mulberry trees, the main raw material in the creation of traditional Hanji.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.4 <4>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Spring of Changdeokgung Palace: The Back Garden of Nakseonjae <16>
programme.desc: Built during King Taejong’s reign, Changdeokgung Palace was originally constructed as a secondary palace but served as the main palace for a longer period. Its rear garden, the only palace rear garden in Korea, showcases beautiful springtime scenery.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Peaceful Mudflats: The Life of the Mudskipper, Shinan Mudflats <6>
programme.desc: Constituting 85% of Korea's UNESCO-designated tidal flats, Shinan Mudflats are the largest and most unique, formed among numerous islands. Explore the charming life of the mudskipper in this ecologically valuable area.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Coloring the Crimson: Dyeing in Royal Red <86>
programme.desc: Royal red, extracted from safflower petals, was once reserved for royalty. The repeated soaking and coloring bring out its deep hue. Witness how this noble color is born through layers of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Drops of Crimson Tears: Brewing Red Liquor <76>
programme.desc: Grains, yeast, and the patience of time come together to create deep crimson liquor. Distilled in the traditional way, Jindo Hongju carries the warmth of the land and the devotion of its maker.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Flowering Devotion: Shoe Making Master <65>
programme.desc: Traditional Korean shoes, delicately stitched petal by petal, are more than footwear—they embody beauty, craftsmanship, and heartfelt wishes. Each step in their making reflects generations of devotion passed down through time.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Echoes of a Thousand Years: Musical Instrument Master <64>
programme.desc: At the heart of Korean rhythm is the janggu, the traditional hourglass drum. From wood shaping to skin tightening, each step carries a legacy of sound and craftsmanship.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Blooming from Paper: Traditional Jihwa <58>
programme.desc: Cut, folded, and twisted into bloom, these paper flowers hold layers of sincerity and hope. Once adorning palaces and sacred spaces, jihwa blossoms again in the hands of devoted artisans. Let the soft rustle of paper whisper the timeless breath of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Soaring Squid: Jeolla Province Ritual Food Master <72>
programme.desc: In southern Korea, a dried squid transforms into a phoenix on the ritual table. This delicate food art, rooted in care and reverence, embodies the spirit and blessing of traditional ceremonies.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Creating a Four-Legged Table: Wooden Furniture Master <49>
programme.desc: Carpenters are artisans who make windows, woodenware, and wooden furniture. They continue the traditional woodworking techniques, creating works like the Sabangtakja (four-sided table). Appreciate the works of Carpenters.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Way of the Scholar: Nakjukjangdo <46>
programme.desc: Jangdo is a small knife carried on the body for daily use, self-defense, or as an ornament. Nakjukjangdo is a traditional knife made using the Nakjuk technique. Appreciate Nakjukjangdo, used while walking the path of scholars.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Welcome Spring: Royal Confectionery Spring Table <1>
programme.desc: Capturing the perfect snack that matches spring best, the sounds of making royal confectionery. Experience the taste and style filled with the scent of spring.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Brush Made with Soul: Brush Master <37>

programme.desc: Makgeolli Brewing,' is a part of our everyday culture and a National Intangible Cultural Heritage. Experience the Makgeolli from Jeoncheon Deoksan Brewery, which adheres to traditional techniques.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Time of Patience to Become a Masterpiece: Floor Carving <53>
programme.desc: This video captures the floor carving process of the inkstone master. Experience the persistent and tenacious inkstone-making process of the master through this ASMR video.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Enduring the Summer Heat: Mat Weaving <57>
programme.desc: In the sweltering summer, hands weave coolness from strands of sedge. Each mat, boiled, dried, and tightly woven, holds the wisdom of tradition and the breath of community.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving Gentle Light: Jade Crafting <24>
programme.desc: Jade has long been treasured as a symbol of virtue in Eastern culture. In the hands of a master artisan, raw jade is selected, shaped, and polished into refined beauty. Each carving reveals not only technique, but the quiet elegance of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Traditional Martial Arts, Archery: Crafting Arrows <22>
programme.desc: Hwanghakjeong, established in 1898, is a traditional archery range founded to demonstrate the spirit of Joseon Dynasty, which is not broken by foreign forces, beyond simply being an art of mental and physical training.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Essence of Korean Traditional Dance: Salpuri Dance <34>
programme.desc: Since ancient times, people have held shamanistic rituals to dispel bad luck for the year. The Salpuri dance is an improvised dance performed by shamans during these rituals to ward off negative energy.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Mystical Hidden Scenery: Jusanji Pond, Cheongsong EP.2 <10>
programme.desc: Completed in 1720, Jusanji Pond is fed by clear waters from Byeolbawi Rock and surrounded by lush forests of Juwangsan Mountain, creating a serene, otherworldly atmosphere.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Garden that Calms the Mind: Soswaewon Garden, Damyang <14>
programme.desc: Created by Yang San-bo in Damyang, Soswaewon is a beautiful garden symbolizing the dignified character and integrity of Korean scholar-officials from the Joseon Dynasty.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carrying on Korea’s Archery Tradition: Bow and Arrow Making Master <93>
programme.desc: Bamboo, horn, sinew, and wood come together to form a traditional bow and arrow. Each material is carefully shaped through countless steps, preserving Korea’s long archery tradition. Listen to the rhythm of carving and polishing.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Life Immersed in Sound: Jeju Folk Songs <7>
programme.desc: Jeju folk songs are songs sung to overcome the hard labor of Jeju people’s lives. Enjoy the Jeju folk songs imbued with their life and emotions.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving Gentle Light: Jade Crafting <24>
programme.desc: Jade has long been treasured as a symbol of virtue in Eastern culture. In the hands of a master artisan, raw jade is selected, shaped, and polished into refined beauty. Each carving reveals not only technique, but the quiet elegance of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Continuing Tradition and Taste: Making Jang <14>
programme.desc: Korean ancestors believed that the taste of Korean food is determined by the quality of Jang (fermented sauces), and without good Jang, there can’t be good food. Experience the deep taste through traditional Jang making.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Hand Skills of Joseon Artisans: Hat Making Master <77>
programme.desc: The tanggeon, a horsehair hat once worn under the gat, reflected dignity in the daily lives of Joseon men. Densely woven by skilled hands, it reveals the calm elegance and restraint found in traditional craftsmanship.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Patience in Preserving Tradition: Onggi Master <13>
programme.desc: Onggi, which every Korean household used to have at least four or five, if not dozens, were essential in traditional Korean kitchens. Feel the patience in preserving the tradition of Onggi masters.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Thousands of Scissor Cuts: Preparing the Pyebaek Table <88>
programme.desc: On the traditional wedding table, squid is transformed into a phoenix through thousands of cuts and rolls. Each motion reflects a heartfelt wish for blessings. Listen closely to the artistry of ritual cuisine.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Overcoming Time of Patience: Selecting Hairs <52>
programme.desc: In the traditional brush-making process, the process of selecting hairs, known as 'Jeongmo work,' is essential for creating a quality brush. Let's appreciate the artisan enduring the time of patience through thousands of repetitions.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Full of Sensations: Royal Confectionery Tea Table <2>
programme.desc: Let’s make a tea table full of sensations! Experience various delicacies filled with dedication and handmade taste, such as mugwort rice cake balls (Ssukguridan) and twisted flour dough flower rice cakes.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: Middle-aged filmmaker Josh Srebnick (Ben Stiller) and his wife, Cornelia (Naomi Watts), are happily married, but stuck in a rut. So, when free-spirited couple Jamie (Adam Driver) and Darby (Amanda Seyfried) enter their lives, it's like a breath of fresh air -- especially for Josh, who pines for a youth he wishes he had. Soon, Josh and Cornelia are ditching friends their own age to hang out with the hipsters -- but whether the friendship can endure despite a 20-year age gap remains to be seen.

A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: In a society ruled by genetically enhanced elites, outcasts Leon (Tom Felton) and Chloe fight to expose corruption and challenge a system built on genetic disparity. Directed by Timo Vuorensola (Iron Sky), Altered is a gripping sci-fi thriller of resistance, justice, and survival.

programme.title: Tuesday
programme.desc: A mother (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) and her daughter must confront Death when it arrives in the form of an astonishing talking bird. A heart-rending fairy tale about the echoes of loss and finding resilience in the unexpected.

programme.title: Ex Machina
programme.desc: Alex Garland, writer of 28 Days Later and Sunshine, makes his directorial debut with the stylish and cerebral thriller, EX MACHINA. Caleb Smith (Domhnall Gleeson), a programmer at an internet-search giant, wins a competition to spend a week at the private mountain estate of the company's brilliant and reclusive CEO, Nathan Bateman (Oscar Isaac).

programme.title: Horns
programme.desc: Blamed for the murder of his girlfriend, a man (Daniel Radcliffe) awakes one morning to find he has grown a pair of horns. Armed, now, with supernatural powers, he sets out to find the killer.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: After his father, an assassin, is brutally murdered, Nick Gant vows revenge on Division, the covert government agency that dabbles in psychic warfare and experimental drugs. Hiding in Hong Kong's underworld, Nick assembles a band of rogue psychics dedicated to destroying Division. Together with Cassie, a teenage clairvoyant, Nick goes in search of a missing girl and a stolen suitcase that could be the key to accomplishing their mutual goal.

programme.title: Project Ithaca
programme.desc: A malevolent alien species has been abducting humans for decades...possibly centuries. Their endgame: to harvest enough human emotional energy to open a wormhole through which their spacecrafts can pass and conquer our world.

programme.title: Unlikely Angel
programme.desc: A country music singer meets an untimely demise and learns she can't enter heaven until she performs a good deed on Earth. She must find a mother for a widowed father and his two children.

programme.title: I, Frankenstein
programme.desc: Two centuries after Dr. Frankenstein assembles and reanimates his creature, Adam is still living. He becomes embroiled in a war between two immortal races: gargoyles, the traditional protectors of mankind, and evil demons. Since Adam is neither human nor demon, gargoyle Queen Leonore and demon Prince Naberius each want him for their own purposes. It is up to Adam to discover his inner humanity and the reason for his continued existence.

programme.desc: In 1997, a major war between the United States and the Soviet Union is concluding, and the entire island of Manhattan has been converted into a giant maximum security prison. When Air Force One is hijacked and crashes into the island, the president is taken hostage by a group of inmates. Snake Plissken, a former Special Forces soldier turned criminal, is recruited to retrieve the president in exchange for his own freedom.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter
programme.desc: The modern world holds many secrets, the most astounding being that witches still live among us. Centuries ago, Kaulder managed to slay the all-powerful Witch Queen, decimating her followers in the process. Before her death, she cursed the valiant warrior with her own immortality, separating him from his beloved wife and daughter in the afterlife. Her resurrection now threatens the survival of the human race as Kaulder, the only one of his kind remaining, faces her vengeful wrath.

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: As the son of Zeus, king of the gods, and a mortal woman, Hercules (Kellan Lutz) is blessed with extraordinary strength. Caught in a forbidden love, Hercules is exiled by his stepfather, the king, and sold into slavery. The legendary strongman endures harrowing battles and death matches in the gladiators' arena, and must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom, overthrow its traitorous ruler and restore peace to the land.

programme.title: Love in Aruba
programme.desc: Amber joins single father Connor overseas in Aruba to tutor and watch over his daughter, Macey, while he focuses on work.

programme.title: No Vacancy
programme.desc: A jaded reporter is demoted to a rural news station, where she befriends a recovering addict and gets involved with a church's plans to transform an old motel into housing for homeless families.

programme.title: Learning to Love
programme.desc: Harry struggles to connect with his two daughters when they lose their faith after losing their mom. When they are faced with the prospect of a new nanny, they are pleasantly surprised by Steph, who floods their hearts with warmth and positivity.

programme.title: Amazing Racer
programme.desc: A teenager (Julianne Michelle) overcomes a tragic loss by working with a talented racehorse and establishing a relationship with the mother (Claire Forlani) she never knew.

programme.title: Courting Mom and Dad
programme.desc: With help from an eccentric attorney, three children hatch an elaborate scheme to prevent their mother and father from divorcing.

programme.title: Champion
programme.desc: Dirt track racer Sean Weathers (Andrew Cheney) was at the top of his game with an unstoppable career. When a rivalry with another racer turns personal, the ego that propelled him to success causes a tragedy, sending his life into a tailspin. Jack Reed (Gary Graham) had prospered as a businessman but failed as a family man. In a sudden turn of events, his chances for reconciliation are ripped from his grasp. Sean and Jack's lives collide, and an unexpected bond forms between them.

programme.title: Summer Snow
programme.desc: Hallie, a small girl with a big heart, comes up with creative ways to help others, leaving her father Dan with a mess to clean up. When his wife dies, Dan struggles to keep it together while caring for his three children.

programme.title: Indivisible
programme.desc: Fresh out of the seminary and basic training, Army chaplain Darren Turner receives orders to deploy to Iraq, leaving his wife behind to care for their three young children. The harsh realities of war soon take their toll on Turner and his battalion, making it hard to stay connected to his beloved family. When Darren finally comes home, the Turners must decide if they're willing to face one more battle -- the fight to save their marriage.

programme.title: Retreat to Paradise
programme.desc: Sparks fly between a physical therapist and an injured tennis star who is temporarily living at a tropical resort.

programme.title: Steps of Faith: Hope's Journey
programme.desc: Samson finds his way back to God.

programme.title: Finding Love in Quarantine
programme.desc: Forced into quarantine, single father Rick Baldwin tries to keep his sanity while searching for love online.

programme.title: The Girl Who Believes in Miracles
programme.desc: When young Sara hears a preacher say faith can move mountains, she starts praying. Suddenly, people in her town are mysteriously healed -- but fame soon takes its toll.

programme.title: Wedding Screeners
programme.desc: When a late wife's last wish is for her husband to remarry, his daughters insist on prescreening potential candidates, soon realizing that happiness might not be as simple as checking all the boxes.

programme.desc: Inspirational speaker Mario King pursues fame, but temptation leads him down a path of destruction. When forced to take community service work at a homeless shelter, Mario finds his faith and his calling.

programme.title: The Abigail Mysteries

programme.desc: On September 1, 1939, Germany invaded Poland in a blitzkrieg fueled not only by tactics and technology, but also by Pervitin-crystal meth. programme.title: WWII: Capitulation
programme.desc: May 8, 1945. While the Allied troops were parading through liberated towns to cheering crowds, the Second World War was in its final, apocalyptic hours. programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: In 1939, bombers hit Polish cities, sparking fear and evacuations. By 1940, Britain faced the Blitz, though early German raids targeted airfields. Both Axis and Allies believed air attacks could break morale. The war revealed that bombing had no boundaries-and civilians were on the front lines.

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: In 1939, bombers hit Polish cities, sparking fear and evacuations. By 1940, Britain faced the Blitz, though early German raids targeted airfields. Both Axis and Allies believed air attacks could break morale. The war revealed that bombing had no boundaries-and civilians were on the front lines.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: Eisenhower describes how the Allies squeezed Rommel's forces in Tunisia. The Afrika Korps attacks to the Kasserine Pass but is pushed back thanks to Patton. Allied air power helps win the day, the U.S. and British 8th Armies meet, and Tunis falls.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: America's Greatest Generals
programme.desc: A profile of General Dwight D. Eisenhower with a bonus program on General Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: In 2016, over 200 unseen photos of Nazi officials surfaced, revealing the rise of a young Hitlerite group in concentration camps between 1928-1943. Dr. Stefan Hördler spent 5 years analyzing the images, uncovering how these men became perpetrators of horrific crimes. This investigation exposes a little-known chapter of the camps and challenges assumptions about their origins.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: 'Tell it to the Chaplain' is a favorite expression of servicemen. This is the tale of a chaplain who, every Sunday, held services amidst ear-splitting gunfire in the fox holes. But when their officer was wounded, the men didn't need a Chaplain, they needed leadership to face oncoming Germans. This Chaplain didn't let his boys down, improving leadership, not taught at O.C.S., to repel the attack.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: Operation Dewey Canyon, from January 22 through March 18, 1969, was the last major offensive by the United States Marine Corps during the Vietnam War. The 9th Marine Regiment reinforced by elements of the 3rd Marine Regiment swept through the A Shau Valley engaging in 56 days of combat mainly against the North Vietnamese Army.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: After training in Australia and New Zealand, the U.S. Marines land on Guadalcanal. The U.S. Navy suffers defeats by the Japanese Navy around the island-in an area called Ironbottom Sound.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: After training in Australia and New Zealand, the U.S. Marines land on Guadalcanal. The U.S. Navy suffers defeats by the Japanese Navy around the island-in an area called Ironbottom Sound.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: The great rivers of the Rhineland along Germany's western border must be crossed to take the fight to the enemy's home turf. A series of interlocking ground and air operations begin in the North with Montgomery commanding a cooperative of American, British and Canadian forces. The soldiers of the Third Reich are dug in deep, however, and the going will be tough, and price of success will be high.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Invasion of Southern France by the 7th army and subsequent junction with the American 3rd army in northwest part of France.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: American Army and Marine forces land unopposed and meet little resistance as they split Okinawa in half. Later, as armies move north and south, fighting grows more fierce. In the southern half, stiff Japanese resistance and rain bog down offensive operations. In the end, the Battle of Okinawa proves costly for both sides.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler the Drifter
programme.desc: Drawing upon the often overlooked memoirs of his erstwhile friend Reinhardt Hanisch and revisiting the key sites on his journey, this powerful film traces Hitler's wilderness years in Vienna and Munich. Using rare archive film and new footage of his boyhood home we follow Hitler's descent from aspiring art student to homeless drifter living in a men's shelter in Vienna.

programme.title: 3 Days in the Life of Lt. Kravtsov
programme.desc: This story underscores the harsh realities of war and the profound impact it has on young soldiers like Lt. Kravtsov. It raises questions about sacrifice, the fragility of life, and the emotional toll of warfare. Will Lt. Kravtsov defy the odds and survive his assigned three days? The answer remains uncertain in this poignant narrative of youth and the cost of war.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In this first film of the series, '1939', follow the prelude to war and consider how the Treaty of Versailles, drawn up after the First World War, failed to keep the peace. Watch the rise of Adolf Hitler and Nazi Germany and learn of those who attempted to stop his bid for global domination. See for yourself the preparations made by the people of Britain as war became inevitable.

The soldiers of the Third Reich are dug in deep, however, and the going will be tough, and price of success will be high.

programme.title: Heroes Never Die: The Miniseries

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: 'Tell it to the Chaplain' is a favorite expression of servicemen. This is the tale of a chaplain who, every Sunday, held services amidst ear-splitting gunfire in the fox holes. This Chaplain didn't let his boys down, improving leadership, not taught at O.C.S., to repel the attack.

programme.desc: Eisenhower brings in the Airborne Divisions to reinforce the Allied front lines, a legendary US General leads a furious charge up country to relieve the surrounded town of Bastogne, and Hitler panics as the German offensive begins to stall..

programme.title: Broken Arrows: The Lost Bombs of the Cold War
programme.desc: The 1966 Palomares B-52 crash occurred on 17 January 1966, when a B-52G bomber and a KC-135 tanker collided. The damage and radiation still exists to this day. In 1968 a B-52 bomber near Thule Air Base in Greenland crashed onto sea ice in North Star Bay. The explosives aboard to detonated and the nuclear payload to rupture and dispersed, resulting in radioactive contamination.

programme.title: Hunting Down The Nazis
programme.desc: Simon Wiesenthal, a survivor of the death camps, is hunting down his torturers, from the camp Kapos to Mengele, the mad doctor of Auschwitz. Lawyer and historian Serge Klarsfeld, whose father was deported and murdered, has devoted his life to searching for Nazi leaders still at large. For the first time a film recounts the story of the long pursuit of Nazis in hiding, from 1945 to the present day.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War

programme.desc: Pee Wee Donovan became a first aid man after promising his mother he wouldn't hurt anyone. Amidst the chaos of mortar and machine gun fire during the 1944 Battle of Hurtgen Forest, he and another aid carried a severely injured soldier through enemy territory. Faced with danger, Pee Wee forgot his promise and fought bravely, leading to heroic moments that create a thrilling and heartwarming story.

programme.desc: This documentary traces the battle for Stalingrad, which proved to be the turning point for the Allies on the eastern front during the Second World War. Included is expert analysis by Dr Duncan Anderson and Dr Aryk Nusbacher. The bitter, bloody and inhuman struggle for Stalingrad was the turning point of the war on the eastern front and a pivotal moment of World War Two.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Hours before the start of Operation Barbarossa, the Germans, along with their Finnish allies, begin mining the Gulf of Finland to prevent any naval evacuation of Soviet troops and ships. When Operation Barbarossa begins, Axis U-boats begin pounding the grand Soviet Navy, primarily based at Leningrad.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: A day by day documentary on the preparation of US troops prior to the D Day invasion and the immediate aftermath after the successful capture of the Normandy Beaches.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: The Big Picture shows you what happens in one day of war. 'The Army Combat Team,' which has proved itself in the Korean fighting, is shown in action. The Big Picture focuses on the man and the machines of this team in the rugged terrain of the Korean peninsula.

programme.title: Troopship Tragedy: The Sinking Of The SS Mendi
programme.desc: February 1917. To provide logistical support to WWI troops, a troopship of volunteers from the South African Native Labour Contingent is sent to France. The men never arrive. A story endures of the final hours before the volunteers drowned, when a charismatic Xhosa priest called the men to dance a warrior dance on deck as they ship sunk into the freezing water.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: In 1945, the U.S. ended WWII with atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, killing over 180,000. But the bomb's story began in Nazi Germany, prompting Roosevelt's $26B Manhattan Project to beat Hitler-and the Soviets-in a race for the A-bomb. Through archives and eyewitnesses, this film reveals the fierce arms race that shaped the fate of the world.

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: What had seemed to be an economic recovery is revealed to have been at best fragile and the world enters a global depression of unprecedented and unmeasurable savagery. Unemployment, hyperinflation and despair are everywhere and dictators arise. Old empires - Britain and France - come under pressure throughout the extended territories that they can barely afford to police.

programme.title: Wings of Destruction

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific examines the growth of independence movements in Asia in the wake of World War II. In the Dutch East Indies, Sukarno declares Indonesian independence and defeat Dutch efforts to retake their colony. In India, the British hands over control to Jawaharlal Nehru. The two new nations soon come to conflict in the region of Kashmir.

programme.title: Battle For The Atlantic: Greyhound vs Wolfpack - Western Approaches
programme.desc: Western Approaches is a vast area of ocean control covering thousands of square miles of the Atlantic. In these waters is set this single incident in the fiercest and longest sea battle in history. The players are not professional actors but serving officers and men of Allied Navies and Merchant Fleets. This film is dedicated to them and their comrades who made the Allied victory possible.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In this third film of the series, '1941', see how Adolf Hitler increased the Nazi stranglehold on Europe, while Winston Churchill inspired the people of Britain to stand together as the nightly Luftwaffe bombing raids were extended to include the nation's vital ports, as well as the capital, London.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: June 5th, 1944, 9:30 PM. 13,348 men from two American parachute divisions, the 82nd and the 101st Airborne in nearly 1,000 aircraft will take off to Normandy. Until then, no one had launched an airborne operation of this scale. The Allied staff is expecting huge losses! Some forecasts predict 75% of the paratroopers will fall in combat. They must open the way to the troops landing on Utah Beach.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: The Falklands War
programme.desc: The Battle between the UK and Argentina over claims to the Falkland Islands systematically merged weapons technology of air, sea, and ground. A UK invasion yielded a bombardment of speed, weaponry and destruction.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Amateur filmmakers in Normandy secretly documented daily life between 1939-1945, risking arrest under Nazi rule. Preserved for decades, their footage reveals war's darkest hours-shortages, fear, and ruins-yet also family bonds, joy, and hope. This documentary offers an extraordinary civilian perspective, intertwining anonymous lives with the unfolding tragedy and liberation of WWII.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Germany is retreating on all fronts and suffering defeat after defeat. The breach of Germany's pre-War borders now seems inevitable. Desperate, Hitler orders all males between the ages of 16 and 70 to enlist and fight for the fatherland. Nazi ideologues put faith in victory and the Nazis seem to vanquish and suppress all forms of doubt and resistance in the last months of the Reich.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: This program is a unique examination of the history of courage among American fighting men and of the Medal of Honor which was developed in tribute to that quality. We examine the American revolutionary times, the Civil War, the War of 1812, the Indian War, the Spanish-American War, the two world wars, and the Korean and Vietnam conflicts. The host of the film is John Daly.

programme.title: War Machines

Some were used, others were not-but all redefined the scale of warfare and the terrifying potential of future conflicts.

programme.desc: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. programme.title: Highlander II: Renegade Version
programme.desc: In this sci-fi/fantasy sequel, Connor MacLeod (Christopher Lambert) has become an elderly man after losing his immortality. Living in a bleak future where the world is protected from solar radiation by a massive shield, MacLeod regains his youth when he kills two assassins from his home planet. This results in an ongoing battle with the villainous and powerful Gen. Katana (Michael Ironside), but MacLeod receives help when the noble Juan Ramirez (Sean Connery) returns.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: While battling a trio of rampaging giants, the legendary half-demon Hellboy encounters Nimue the Blood Queen, an ancient resurrected sorceress who's out to avenge a past betrayal. Suddenly caught in a clash between the supernatural and the human, Hellboy soon becomes hell-bent on stopping Nimue without triggering the end of the world.

programme.title: Nurse
programme.desc: A young nurse (Katrina Bowden) begins to suspect that a sexy colleague (Paz de la Huerta) is responsible for murdering a string of unfaithful men.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After carefree teenager Jay (Maika Monroe) sleeps with her new boyfriend, Hugh (Jake Weary), for the first time, she learns that she is the latest recipient of a fatal curse that is passed from victim to victim via sexual intercourse. Death, Jay learns, will creep inexorably toward her as either a friend or a stranger. Jay's friends don't believe her seemingly paranoid ravings, until they too begin to see the phantom assassins and band together to help her flee or defend herself.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Separated from their father (Michael Kelly), two teenage sisters (Sofia Black-D'Elia, Analiegh Tipton) try to survive an apocalyptic viral outbreak that leads to a quarantine.

programme.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
programme.desc: Beautiful Mandy Lane (Amber Heard) isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe (Whitney Able) invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: Ten years ago, an inexperienced coal miner named Tom Hanniger caused an accident that killed five men and put a sixth, Harry Warden, into a coma. A year later, on Valentine's Day, Harry woke up and murdered 22 people with a pickaxe before dying. Now Tom has returned home, still haunted by the past. And something else is back in Harmony: a pickaxe-wielding killer in a miner's mask, who may be the ghost of Harry, come to claim Tom and his friends.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: Tough and chiseled Ray Breslin (Sylvester Stallone) knows how to infiltrate a prison -- and bust out of one. Only sadistic warden Hobbes (Jim Caviezel) stands in the way of the two men successfully making it out alive.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs

programme.title: Murderous Affairs

programme.title: Murderous Affairs

programme.title: Murderous Affairs

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In Denver, Colorado, a mistress plots revenge when she's dumped, and in a small community north of Stockholm, Sweden, a deeply religious woman believes she's receiving messages from God - to kill.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In Chicago, Illinois, a millionaire meets an exotic dancer with a secret agenda, and in Marion, Ohio, friends suspect the worst when a wife and mother goes missing.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: An internet love triangle leads to deception and murder near Buffalo, New York. On the outskirts of London, England, a romantic stroll through the woods ends with a brutal attack.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In Goode, Virginia, a 50-year age gap proves a nightmare for a wealthy retired businessman and his violent girlfriend. In Austin, Texas, a millionaire wakes up and thinks his stomach has torn apart - but then discovers he's been shot.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In Merrillville, Indiana, there are deadly secrets between family members, while near Manchester, England, a late night flower delivery proves a test run for murder.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In Kansas City, Missouri, a married woman falls for a street hustler and pays a devastating price. In Castlerock, Northern Ireland, a married dentist falls for a patient, and comes up with an unusual treatment plan to secure a fresh start.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In Lebanon, Maine, an estranged wife trying to start a new life can't escape her violent past, while in Vincennes, Indiana, a married engineer falls for the babysitter and leads her on a downward path...to murder.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In Ventura, California, a wife goes missing after a mysterious arrest, while in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, thousands of dollars stored in shoe boxes provides a vital clue to solve a murder.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: On an unusually warm September morning beloved yoga instructor Michael Dojaquez is found shot dead on his front porch. With a rash of violent home burglaries reported in his Tucson neighborhood in recent weeks, detectives line up the usual suspects only to find themselves spinning down the rabbit hole of a bizarre 'love triangle' homicide investigation with no murder weapon and the perfect alibi.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: An unsolved shooting in 2003 is linked to two similar murders, a decade later. Ballistics evidence links all three to an unusual bullet type - and even more unusual murder weapons. Law enforcement tracks down an unlikely serial killer: a man who had run for mayor and congress.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: When a man's family and co-workers lose touch with him and can't find any trace of him for days, the police are sent to his apartment to investigate and see what they can figure it out. But what they find is far worse than any of them expected.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Pamela Hutchinson travels to Florida to attend a friend's funeral, but after extending her stay, she's found dead in her condo's bathroom. The local police launch into an investigation, unveiling a threat that spans across the United States.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Random shootings, rapes, and robberies leave almost all of the residents of Phoenix, Arizona scared. On top of that, authorities are seemingly powerless against serial killers that are waging a war of terror on the streets of this Arizona city.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Keith Gentry is shot in his sleep in the middle of the night, and left to be found by his wife, Darlene. The Texas Rangers are then brought in to investigate the murder, wading through discrepancies and lies as they narrow in on their suspect.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Trenton Mallory and fiance Amber Smith of Levering, Michigan have had their ups and downs in recent years. Things finally seem to be on the upswing when 'Trading Trent' as he is known because of his hobby of buying and selling guns is found shot in his bed while still asleep.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Jeremy Simko is a firearms enthusiast whose property is outfitted with every conceivable security device, from motion detectors, to cameras, to savage, barking dogs. So when his wife Julene finds him shot to death in their bed one night, the question for police is, how could an intruder possibly have gained access to the Simko bedroom?

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Tireless nurse Bonnie Woodward would never simply disappear and leave her family behind - that's not the type of person she was. After she is murdered, investigators believe they have her killer but it takes 10 years to break the case wide open.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: When a Texas oil tycoon's badly decomposing body is found in his beauty queen girlfriend's mansion, police fear the worst and issue a nationwide alert to find her. But when they learn their relationship has recently been rocky, no one is sure whether they're hunting for a victim...or a killer.

programme.title: Inside Broadmoor
programme.desc: Broadmoor is Britain's most notorious hospital prison for the criminally insane, whose infamous inmates have included Ronnie Kray and 'Yorkshire Ripper' Peter Sutcliffe. Currently Broadmoor houses 400 of the most difficult, disturbed and dangerous people in Britain. With material from the hospital, this film offers unique insight into how a civilised society treats those who are both bad and mad.

programme.title: Diana: The New Evidence
programme.desc: Over twenty years on, there are still questions about the terrible crash that killed Princess Diana, Dodi Al Fayed and the driver Henri Paul. This new film brings the story up to date with new evidence not seen before on T.V. It reports allegations made by a French witness that there was a conspiracy to kill Princess Diana and the details of how that caused the fatal crash in the Alma Tunnel.

programme.title: Hunting Down The Nazis
programme.desc: Simon Wiesenthal, a survivor of the death camps, is hunting down his torturers, from the camp Kapos to Mengele, the mad doctor of Auschwitz. Lawyer and historian Serge Klarsfeld, whose father was deported and murdered, has devoted his life to searching for Nazi leaders still at large. For the first time a film recounts the story of the long pursuit of Nazis in hiding, from 1945 to the present day.

programme.title: Lord Lucan: My Husband, The Truth
programme.desc: The 40 year mystery uncovered by his wife. This is the story of Lord Lucan, playboy, aristocrat, gambler and murderer. The public has been transfixed for over 40 years, when on November 7th, 1974 Lucan family nanny Sandra Rivett was killed and he disappeared without a trace. Ever since, one voice has remained almost entirely silent; his wife, Lady Lucan. Now she wants to set the record straight.
