programme.desc: A comprehensive round-up of the biggest news stories of the day, including analysis and insight from Sky News correspondents across the UK and around the world.

programme.title: Endangered Civilizations
programme.desc: Between the Sahara and the equatorial rainforest of West Africa, the huge cliff of Bandiagara stretches across a desolate plateau. This vast wall of rock is home to one of the world's most unique civilizations - the Dogon. Their animist beliefs are founded on a refined tradition based on a beautiful legend : the Ark of the First Ancestor.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: We all know about Heracles' unequalled strength, and the twelve labours he had to carry out, but we know a great deal less about the way in which his life was turned upside down by a series of terrible curses.

programme.title: Henry VIII: The Tyrant King and His Six Wives
programme.desc: In the initial episode Tracy Borman shows us exclusive access to parts of Henry VII's life. From his wedding bed to the Tudor Bedding Ceremony and the realities of childbirth. We learn more about the Tudor's philosophy on sex and extramarital affairs as it pertains to Henry VII.

programme.title: The Real Joan of Arc
programme.desc: The myth of Joan of Arc has fascinated people the world over. In the collective memory, she is the young shepherd girl who died at the stake having saved France. But 15th century chronicles report that following events in Rouen, certain people refused to believe she was dead and that another woman was burned instead.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Hermes was the youngest of the Gods of Olympus. Right from birth, he was an insolent, thieving, trickster God. While still a baby, he escaped from the cave in which his mother Maia gave birth to him, and stole Apollo's herd.

programme.title: 1000 AD: Anglo-Saxons vs Vikings
programme.desc: What was it really like to live just before the end of the first millennium? 1000 AD recreates life circa 999 AD, showing the everyday lives, loves and passions of the Anglo-Saxon people. A soap opera-style drama runs alongside interviews with leading historians who paint a revealing picture of the political and social structure of pre-Norman Britain.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: In Saqqara desert, south of Cairo, stands a little-known monument whose walls are covered with exceptional texts: the pyramid of Pepi II - Egypt's longest reigning pharaoh. Its funerary chambers house the oldest collection of religious texts in the world! Experts are now able to scan the structure in the hope to solve its many enigmas.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Versailles
programme.desc: French people are starving, but the aristocracy is too busy partying inside the palace of Versailles to take notice. Louis tries to make a difference, but every attempt at reform is blocked by his greedy relatives. As he drifts into depression and madness, Louis and his Queen attempt to stave off a revolution, pleading with the nobility to accept reform. But it is too late.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Having become organiser of the world, Zeus entrusted the world of the sea to his brother Poseidon, and the underworld, or the kingdom of the dead, to Hades. Alone, in a place he had not chosen himself, Hades reigned over the people of the shadows and over the grimacing creatures that surrounded him.

programme.title: Megapolis: The Ancient World Revealed
programme.desc: In the 4th century BC, Alexander the Great envisioned Alexandria, a humble fishing village, as a cosmopolitan megacity. Its strategic location made it a thriving hub, hosting up to 1 million people. Witness its revolutionary urban design and iconic structures like the Great Library and the Lighthouse.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: The tomb of the last queen of Egypt has never been found, despite experts searching for centuries. While many historians believe it is located near a temple to Isis, East of ancient Alexandria, new discoveries indicate that it might be near Taposiris Magna. Through field excavations, 3D modeling and reenactments, this documentary series will retrace the life of Cleopatra.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some places are charged with psychic energy, still traveled by spirits that haven't passed on. Edd and Beth's new home seems ideal, but soon they see a transparent man, a misty old woman, and a growing dark cloud. As supernatural forces intensify, a paranormal investigator confirms their fears. Their home is a portal, filled with enough negative energy to erupt into something terrifying.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: April and Matt buy a Victorian home in Salt Lake City, eager to restore it. But an unseen force detests change. Renovations stall, voices whisper, and April's son sees movement in his closet. Then, a dark entity appears, determined to drive them out. A medium warns that the house holds tormented children's spirits-and if they don't fight back, they too will become forgotten.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Deb and Tony are excited to start their life together in Atchison, Kansas. With their first child on the way, they settle into a charming home, hopeful for the future. After their son is born, his toys move on their own. Deb believes he has a ghostly playmate-until Tony suffers whispers, ghostly footsteps, and bloody wounds. A psychic warns that a darker force is using the spirit to wreak havoc.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Evil thrives on deception, slowly eroding faith and family bonds. Sarah Miller senses something supernatural in her home, terrifying her children and making her question reality. Her boyfriend's skepticism deepens the divide as a demonic force tightens its grip. A religious demonologist identifies a diabolical infestation and prepares a ritual to expel the entity before it destroys them.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Ron and Nancy believe their historic Baltimore home is perfect. But the seller warns, 'I hope you're good fighters.' At first, they battle faulty wiring and strange plumbing issues. Then, objects move on their own, and Nancy dreams of an old woman laughing as their house burns. As the haunting increases, they realize their home is a gateway between life and death-and someone tried to seal it shut.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Time slowly erases reminders of the past. Old roads are abandoned, and their destinations forgotten. When Clara's family moves to rural Hinsdale, NY, they expect peace but find eerie disturbances. Ritualistic chanting echoes from the woods, and neighbors whisper of roaming ghosts. A psychic warns that spirits are drawn to their home-and to a gruesome secret hidden in the crawlspace.

programme.title: Ships That Changed the World
programme.desc: The arrival of menacing German U-Boats in international waters rewrote the rulebook on maritime conflict, and so Britain began rapidly converting its merchant vessels into battleships. Sea battles such as those at Cornell and Jutland saw the two empire's differing approaches put to the test - pitting Germany's sub-surface sneak attacks and strong defenses against Britain's brute force.

programme.title: The Romanovs
programme.desc: The seventh segment chronicles the rule of both Nicolas I and his son Alexander II, as well as the Emancipation Reform of 1861, which succeeded in abolishing serfdom.

programme.title: The Last Journey of the Vikings
programme.desc: Most people regard the Vikings as violent robbers but were much more than that. Get an insight into the changes in their environment and society that forced them to leave Scandinavia.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Theseus was the fruit of dual paternity: Aegeus King of Athens slept with Aethra when she had just been raped by Poseidon, God of the Sea. Theseus, who grew into a strong, brave young man, therefore had a double lineage - both divine and royal. But Theseus' great courage did not stop him from neglecting his duties. Carried along by his victory, he committed a few irreversible oversights.

programme.title: The Viking Myths
programme.desc: Calamities upon catastrophes befall Midgard, endless wars and three years of eternal winter... the signs are unmistakable. Ragnarök is here. The great confrontation between the gods and the forces of darkness is at hand. At the foot of Bifrost, Heimdall warns the gods by blowing his trumpet, but it is too late. Odin consults the head of Mímir, who tells him that the hour has come. The war rages on.

programme.title: Revolt! The American Revolution 1775 - 1783
programme.desc: How is it that thirteen small colonies in North America were able to succeed - against a global power such as Great Britain? Learn about the seven-year war, the Boston Tea Party and the origin of the Declaration of Independence. Once the War of Independence was won, why did it take years to write the Constitution? And what was life like afterwards, and how did Native Americans and slaves fare?

programme.title: Europe - History Seen From Above
programme.desc: Borders reveal scars of conflict-fortresses, bunkers, fortification lines. Nowhere more than between France and Germany, where frontiers shifted with wars and unions. Once a military line of defense, by the 18th century borders became continuous demarcations shaped by rivers and relief. Over time, the Franco-German frontier transformed from a battleground into a fragile line of peace.

programme.title: The Napoleonic Wars - The War of the Sixth Coalition
programme.desc: As Moscow burns in the wake of Napoleon's advance, the Russian army regroups and begins its determined pursuit of the invaders. With winter looming, they launch a relentless counteroffensive, setting the stage for a campaign that will push far beyond Russia's borders.

programme.title: Endangered Civilizations
programme.desc: This boy riding a poney is called Josh Guerrero : he is 8 years old. He is a Lakota. 100 years after the 'Massacre of Wounded Knee', the Sioux Lakota decided to commemorate the death of Big Foot. In spite of dreadful weather conditions, Josh decides to follow up this march, as if it were his own initiatic journey to become an Indian warior.

programme.title: Inside The Tower of London: Crimes, Conspiracies, Confessions
programme.desc: Bishop Bonner, who tortured both Catholics and Protestants in the turbulent years following the reign of Henry VIII; why the Tower was constructed, why it was built, where it is, how it developed and how the first prisoner it held remains the only on etc escape from the White Tower. We also hear about Lady Jane Grey, and speak to a Beefeater about their role and unique traditions.

programme.title: Revolt! The French Revolution 1789 - 1799
programme.desc: It began when revolutionaries stormed a prison called the Bastille. What were the underlying causes for the revolution? What was the Reign of Terror? Who was Maximilian de Robespierre? Then we take a look at the aftermath of the French Revolution and the impact it had on other political ideologies and governments to better understand why this dramatic period was so important in history.

programme.title: Inside The Tower of London: Crimes, Conspiracies, Confessions
programme.desc: Alice Tankerville and her attempts to 'woo' her way out of trouble with a prison guard; how Watt Tyler led the only force to storm the Tower; and how the legend grew that if you took the Tower you took the country.

programme.title: Elizabeth I
programme.desc: The summer of 1586. Elizabeth I was in fear of her life. A group of Catholic extremists were planning to kill her and install her cousin, Mary, Queen of Scots, on her throne. Behind the terrorists was the might of Spain, whose forces were ready to invade were the plot to succeed. But one man stood in the way: Sir Francis Walsingham, Elizabeth's spymaster and security chief.

programme.title: Life in the Time of
programme.desc: In the 17th century, a young man from Gascony wanted to join the prestigious regiments of musketeers of the King of France. To this end, he trains daily in an academy of gentlemen in the handling of weapons and equestrian art. He thus hopes to be noticed by an officer. But the selection is ruthless: you have to be the best to join the Musketeers.

programme.title: George III: The Genius of the Mad King
programme.desc: After 200 years under lock and key, all the personal papers of one of our most important monarchs are seeing the light of day for the first time. In the first documentary to gain extensive access to the Royal Archives, Robert Hardman sheds fascinating new light on George III, Britain's longest-reigning king.

programme.title: The Mystery of Atlit-Yam
programme.desc: In 1984, off Israel's Mediterranean coast, marine archaeologist Ehud Galili discovered an ancient settlement that had been submerged for millennia. The site was at first a mystery, but as underwater excavations progressed, the veil was lifted.

programme.title: The Boer War: 1899-1902
programme.desc: Journey back in time to a different age, when the sun never set on the British Empire and her armies were great in number. The Boer War: 1899-1902 was a turning point in British military history and would revolutionize tactics, battlefield strategy, equipment, and training. Well known participants in the Boar Wars include: Harry 'Breaker' Morant, Winston Churchill and Mahatma Gandhi.

programme.title: The Alchemists
programme.desc: 'La France des Mysteries' invites you to discover the main sites which, in our country, have played a major role in the history of alchemy. From Bourges, which was the capital of alchemy, to the Château du Plessis Bourré which still attracts specialists trying to decipher the symbols engraved in its walls, we will try to unravel the mysteries of a fascinating discipline.

programme.title: Napoleon Bonaparte: The Russian Campaign
programme.desc: Since his victory over Tsar Alexander in 1807 and the Treaty of Tilsit, France and Russia are officially allies. But Alexander doesn't support Napoleon's expansionist strategy. To Napoleon, Russia's behavior makes it an enemy of France. Ignoring calls for caution, Napoleon invades Russia in 1811.

programme.title: The Romanovs
programme.desc: Catherine the Great dominates the fifth episode. An unusually enlightened mind, enraptured by the poetry and philosophy of the time, she enjoyed tremendous public adoration throughout her eventful reign of over three decades.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Dedalus, a prominent Greek inventor, settled in Crete among King Minos' court. Queen Pasiphaë, who had an all-consuming passion for a white bull, called upon his services. Dedalus found a way to allow Pasiphaë to mate with the bull, and Minos locked Daedalus and his son, Icarus, away for their betrayal. Dedalus found a way to escape - but his method put his own son's life in peril.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In Taiwan, many believe the spiritual and material worlds are intertwined. When an American family moves into a lavish mansion in the Yangmingshan Mountains, they witness disturbing supernatural events. Skeptical at first, they refuse to believe in ghosts-until their youngest daughter becomes possessed. A Taoist priest reveals the house was designed to empower the dead and torment the living.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Childhood fear is pure, untempered by adult rationality. After his divorce, Steven LaChance dismisses his children's nightmares as stress-until he experiences chilling disturbances himself. Shadows lurk, screams echo, and an unseen force preys on them. He flees, but when another family moves in, he vows to help them. If you enter the spirit world, the spirits enter yours.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Fahey family has lived in their Galway townhouse for decades. When Martha brings home her newborn, eerie disturbances begin. Unexplained cries echo through the night, objects vanish, and a chilling presence fills the house. A priest offers no relief, but a healer reveals a dark secret-Martha's child has awakened the psychic energy of a long-buried crime that prayer alone cannot erase.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Children often feel powerless in the face of the adult world. In Glen Burnie, Maryland, 10-year-old Billy Bean's life is already in crisis. He and his sister are attacked at night-pinned to their beds by unseen forces. Billy senses an evil presence destroying his family. As the attacks worsen, he fights to uncover the dark secrets of the house on Little Road before he loses everything.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Psychics claim to see the past as if it were unfolding before them. When Suzanna Hadwin visits the Wheatsheaf Pub in North England, she encounters a long-buried mystery. The owners hear whispers and find strange handprints, leading them to use a Ouija board. Their search uncovers evidence of an old murder-hidden behind the very walls of the pub, which soon turns against them.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: On the shores of West Bay Lake, Wisconsin, a mansion known as Summerwind stands between the living and the dead. Ginger falls in love with the house despite warnings and moves in with her family. As she restores it, a supernatural force pushes her husband toward madness. With their family unraveling, Ginger and her children fear the house will consume them all.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: Odysseus' fleet tries to avoid Charybdis, the first sea monster ready to swallow them, but Scylla, a horrible multi-headed creature, destroys three of his ships. The last few hours have been grueling, and the sailors want to rest on the island of Helios, which is now in sight.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: The tomb of the last queen of Egypt has never been found, despite experts searching for centuries. While many historians believe it is located near a temple to Isis, East of ancient Alexandria, new discoveries indicate that it might be near Taposiris Magna. Through field excavations, 3D modeling and reenactments, this documentary series will retrace the life of Cleopatra.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Iliad
programme.desc: The chaos that reigns between Greeks and Trojans has now spread to Mount Olympus. Back on the battlefield, the Trojans have driven back the Greeks, and decide to build a long wall.

programme.title: The Night of the Long Knives: Hitler's Rise to Power
programme.desc: The Night of the Long Knives is considered the first act of horror committed by the Nazis. What happened in Germany, and in Hitler's rise to power, that led to this purge in 1934? Caught between the conservative tendency and the revolutionary aspirations that were dividing the country, the Chancellor had a choice. To calm the rumors of a military coup against him, Hitler sent a clear message.

programme.title: The Viking Myths
programme.desc: A banquet is held in Asgard, during which Loki insults the gods, revealing their weaknesses. His punishment is terrible. Chained under venom that periodically drips on him, he must watch as two of his sons are killed, one of them devouring the other. Odin knows that Ragnarök is not far off, since Loki is now, according to the seer's prediction, in chains. And when he breaks free of his chains...

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Perseus was not meant to come into the world. Fearing the fulfilment of the prediction according to which his grandson would kill him, King Acrisius shut his daughter Danaë away in a fortified tower.

programme.title: King Arthur: The Legend
programme.desc: Rich with dramatic reconstructions and lavish photography of ancient heritage sites and mystic Celtic landscapes, this thrilling programme, reveals how the stories of King Arthur have grown and developed across a thousand years. The Legend is alive and well today, on screen and in print, intriguing a new generation who are in search of an inspiring hero-figure and a Camelot for their own age.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: In Ithaca, Queen Penelope endures the presence of Suitors who covet her hand, and the throne of her husband Odysseus - who disappeared more than 10 years ago.

programme.title: Ships That Changed the World
programme.desc: Harland and Wolff weathered a difficult post-war period of internal turmoil and global depression. But as the world crept towards a second global conflict, renewed demand revitalized the shipbuilder's fortunes. The British Navy required an imposing fleet, as Germany's Scharnhorst and Gneisenau patrolled the seas. But the advent of the aerial age consigned ships to a subservient role.

programme.title: The Viking Myths
programme.desc: To appease Thor's fury, Loki, who has gone to the kingdom of the Dwarves, orders three wondrous objects - among which Thor's hammer, Mjölnir.

programme.title: Gehlen: Hitler's Superspy
programme.desc: Reinhard Gehlen was Hitler's Chief of Intelligence on the Russian Front during WWII. Before May 1945 he had secreted himself and the files on the Soviets away from Berlin. He then bargained for his freedom with the advancing Americans and his files formed the basis of the CIA when it was set up in 1947. The story traces Gehlen's joining the Nazi party to his retirement on a CIA pension.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: Archaeologist Zahi Hawass has been excavating the ancient necropolis of Saqqara, south of Cairo, for several decades. Today, he hopes to discover the tomb of Imhotep, the architect of the first pyramid in the history of mankind: the Step Pyramid of Djoser. With his team, Hawass will unearth marvellous tombs, and the many secrets of the Egyptian mummies they contain...

programme.title: When the Egyptians Sailed on the Red Sea
programme.desc: This multi-awards film is the tale of an extraordinary human and scientific adventure. An adventure in which we are plunged into the technical and psychological world of the Egyptians 3,500 years ago.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Iliad
programme.desc: Saved by Apollo, Hector goes back on the attack and leads the Trojans as far as the Greeks' ships. Patroclus, a childhood friend of Achilles, rushes to him and implores him to re-join the battle.

programme.title: Besieged Fortresses - Legendary Battles
programme.desc: When Saladin invades Jerusalem, Philip Augustus and Richard the Lionheart put their rivalry aside to fight for Saint-John of Acre, a highly strategic port in the Holy land. At the head of 25,000 men, the former enemies take on the Sultan in the first battle of the Third Crusade.

programme.title: The Romanovs
programme.desc: Although he had tremendous foresight in his attempts to modernize Russia and enact effective foreign policies, Peter neglected to name an heir before his death in 1725.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: The Goddess of War Athena was the wisest, most level headed and rational deity. She was born out of Zeus' skull, wearing a helmet and holding a spear. She was the protector of heroes, the State, and mankind, to whom she passed on many inventions.

programme.title: The Napoleonic Wars - The War of the Sixth Coalition
programme.desc: The Battle of Leipzig becomes the largest and bloodiest battle in Europe prior to World War I. Known as the 'Battle of Nations,' it breaks the backbone of Napoleon's army. With France in retreat, Russian troops prepare to take the fight into enemy territory.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: Penelope is now forced to choose a husband among the Suitors. She offers them a test to decide who among them is the most worthy: with the bow of Odysseus, they must shoot an arrow and pass it through twelve axes.

programme.title: Ancient Megacities
programme.desc: Explore the transformation of a humble village into a formidable ancient city atop Turkey's Hissarlik hill. Despite being rebuilt nine times after fires and earthquakes, Troy remains a masterpiece of defensive architecture. Archaeologists continue to uncover its secrets, inspired by the epic tale of the Iliad. Yet, the mystery persists: how did the Mycenaeans penetrate Troy's impregnable defenses?

programme.desc: Embark on a journey to ancient Rome with stunning computer-generated reconstructions. Witness the secrets of Roman architecture and the ingenuity of its builders. Through recent film footage and post-production magic, iconic monuments like the Pantheon, Nero's palace, and the Coliseum are resurrected, showcasing Rome's excellence, innovation, and eternal beauty.

programme.desc: The Bible tells of a man possessed by a legion of demons. In Stamford, Connecticut, 12-year-old David has nightmares of a demonic old man flying toward his home. His terror grows daily. His mother is unsure how to respond-until David is physically attacked by an unseen force. Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren discover demons within him. They must act before he is lost to darkness.

programme.desc: The Bible tells of a man possessed by a legion of demons. In Stamford, Connecticut, 12-year-old David has nightmares of a demonic old man flying toward his home. programme.desc: During World War II, the Nazis began a secret Aryan breeding program called Lebensborn. Born in special nurseries, the children were meant to renew the ranks of the SS in order to ensure the continuation of the Master Race. The fathers of these children were all SS officers, a prerequisite. Illustrated with the testimonies of the victims, this film reveals the insane projects of Adolf Hitler.

programme.title: The Viking Myths
programme.desc: Odin questions a seer, who reveals new details about Ragnarök. The gods and the giants, who have been at war since the beginning of the world, will perish at each other's hands... Monstrous wolves will devour the sun and moon, when Loki breaks free from his chains. Baldr, Odin and Frigg's favorite son, will be dead and without honor.

programme.title: The Viking Myths
programme.desc: Odin questions a seer, who reveals new details about Ragnarök. The gods and the giants, who have been at war since the beginning of the world, will perish at each other's hands... Monstrous wolves will devour the sun and moon, when Loki breaks free from his chains. Baldr, Odin and Frigg's favorite son, will be dead and without honor.

programme.title: Castles & Palaces of Europe
programme.desc: Our journey starts with Hohenzollern Castle, the cradle of the last Prussian reigning family and a symbol of their power: an eagle's nest, perched on a green peak. After a trip to a snail farm, a culinary speciality of Swabia, we discover Ludwigsburg Castle, a small pleasure pavilion that gradually became one of Europe's largest baroque residences.

programme.title: Queen Victoria's Letters: A Monarch Unveiled
programme.desc: AN Wilson reveals that Victoria and Albert's relationship was far from idyllic. Behind closed doors Albert showed his true colours as a control freak.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Ron and Nancy believe their historic Baltimore home is perfect. But the seller warns, 'I hope you're good fighters.' At first, they battle faulty wiring and strange plumbing issues. Then, objects move on their own, and Nancy dreams of an old woman laughing as their house burns. As the haunting increases, they realize their home is a gateway between life and death-and someone tried to seal it shut.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: How would reality change if we couldn't perceive or communicate in conventional ways? For Marie, this question is daily life. Her daughter Julie, unable to walk or talk, interacts with unseen forces. Marie wonders if they're angels-until she comes face to face with a demon. A Ouija board session turns their home into a portal for darkness, proving that evil can lurk in the most ordinary places.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Evil thrives on deception, slowly eroding faith and family bonds. Sarah Miller senses something supernatural in her home, terrifying her children and making her question reality. Her boyfriend's skepticism deepens the divide as a demonic force tightens its grip. A religious demonologist identifies a diabolical infestation and prepares a ritual to expel the entity before it destroys them.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some places are charged with psychic energy, still traveled by spirits that haven't passed on. Edd and Beth's new home seems ideal, but soon they see a transparent man, a misty old woman, and a growing dark cloud. As supernatural forces intensify, a paranormal investigator confirms their fears. Their home is a portal, filled with enough negative energy to erupt into something terrifying.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Fahey family has lived in their Galway townhouse for decades. When Martha brings home her newborn, eerie disturbances begin. Unexplained cries echo through the night, objects vanish, and a chilling presence fills the house. A priest offers no relief, but a healer reveals a dark secret-Martha's child has awakened the psychic energy of a long-buried crime that prayer alone cannot erase.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: America is full of forgotten cemeteries, some buried beneath new homes. Bobby Wilcott buys a historic manor in Indiana, hoping renovations will strengthen his marriage. But strange occurrences strain their bond-doors won't stay shut, lights flicker, and unease grows. Paranormal experts Ed and Lorraine Warren confirm the worst: a demonic presence is feeding on their fear.

programme.title: Henry VIII: The Tyrant King and His Six Wives
programme.desc: Aside from being an unruly tyrant, Henry VIII is well known for his infamous riding accident. Tracy's research reveals the real story and how his ulcerated leg developed and was treated. Related topics explored are medicine and treatments in Tudor times, Henry VIII's fascination with astronomy and the cuisine in Henry's court.

programme.title: Her Majesty The Queen Mother: 1900-2002
programme.desc: When Her Majesty the Queen Mother died peacefully in her sleep aged 101, the nation lost one of its best-loved royals. Throughout her extraordinary life spanning the whole of the 20th century, the Queen Mother had a remarkable ability to reach ordinary people. Her life was one of duty, serving the nation.

programme.title: The Last Seven Months of Anne Frank
programme.desc: Anne Frank's surviving friends tell the story that begins where her famous diary leaves off and for the first time the concentration camp experiences of Anne and her family are told. Amongt the eyewitnesses is Anne Frank's closest friend, identified as 'Lies' in Anne's diary. She was filmed at several locations where she had been with Anne, including Bergen-Belsen concentration camp.

programme.title: Megapolis: The Ancient World Revealed
programme.desc: Megapolis resurrects ancient cities with stunning 3D models. In the Athens episode, witness its transformation from a small hamlet to a pinnacle of Greek civilization under Pericles. Explore iconic structures like the Parthenon and the Propylaea, reflecting the brilliance of ancient Greek democracy and innovation.

programme.title: Ships That Changed the World
programme.desc: Gigantic sea-faring vessels were the pride and joy of late 19th century Europe. An Irish-German alliance of entrepreneurs saw the founding of ship-builders Harland and Wolff in Belfast, fueling the city's industry. Despite disasters such as the Titanic, ship designs became increasingly utilitarian as inter-European tensions increased, epitomized by the arrival of the Dreadnaught in 1906.

programme.title: Europe - History Seen From Above
programme.desc: In 1492, the marriage of Isabella of Castile and Ferdinand of Aragon united Spain, earning them the title of Catholic Monarchs. Their rule ended centuries of Reconquista with the fall of Granada, while Isabella financed Columbus' voyage that unveiled the New World. This discovery sparked Spain's golden age, fueling power, wealth, and influence for more than three centuries.

programme.title: The Last Journey of the Vikings
programme.desc: In the French Empire, the Vikings come face to face with new defenses and Charlemagne refuses to hand over Christian land to pagans and pirates. The defense continues but then changes.

programme.title: Mysteries of Noah and The Flood
programme.desc: The Biblical tale of Noah and the Flood holds an unmatched fascination for people of all ages and cultures. The search for irrefutable evidence of a flood so overwhelming that it divided known history into BEFORE and AFTER...and the search for the Ark itself...have long consumed scientists, explorers, religious scholars and artists.

programme.title: Thunder Run on Baghdad
programme.desc: The Americans are getting ready to seize Baghdad airport, in what is to be the sole battle of this war. Opposite them: the Republican Guard led by Saddam Hussein's son Qusay. Dr. Hana Hammed, an Iraqi woman, wants to meet Qusay in order to have her husband, a prisoner in Abu Ghraib, released.

programme.title: The Destiny of Rome
programme.desc: The Battle of Philippi in 42 BC would change the world forever. Marc Antony and Octavian sought to avenge Caesar, but later fought over his legacy, with the fate of Rome in the balance. They first managed to combine their forces to punish Brutus and Cassius, Caesar's assassins, and to proclaim their legitimacy. But there could only be one successor to Caesar.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lawrenceburg, Kentucky to investigate The Wild Turkey Distillery. Guest investigator, Kristen Luman, as well as two familiar faces, Dustin and KJ join the team. The descendent of the founding family, Olivia Ripy, calls the team in to investigate. Her family started making whiskey as far back as 1869 and in 1935, her grandparents went into business as the Ripy Brothers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hyde Park, New York to investigate the Culinary Institute of America. Built in the early 1900's the building was originally a seminary for young men looking to become Jesuit priests. It was shut down in 1969 due to diminishing enrollment. The Culinary Institute took over the building two years later.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home on this investigation as they travel to Newport, Rhode Island to investigate Fort Adams, the largest coastal fortress ever constructed on US soil. This is the second fort built on the site. The original structure was built in 1799 and stood through 1812. The fort was rebuilt from 1824-1857 and could hold 468 cannons, where as the first could only hold 20. Many deaths were reported but had nothing to do with battle but rather, murder, suicide, and illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Bennington, Vermont to investigate Southern Vermont College. Edward Everett was a wealthy man who built his mansion on these grounds between 1911-1914. He was married twice and had 5 children. When he died in 1929 his estimated worth was between $40-$50 million. The legend that students have passed down through the years is that Edward's first wife, Amy, committed suicide, and didn't die of poor health, which was reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the Conrad-Caldwell Castle, the masterpiece built by well-known architect, Arthur Loomis. The house took 3 years to complete and was the symbol of success for the original owner, Theophilus Conrad and his wife, who started out as poor immigrants before working their way up to being wealthy industrialists. The couple lived in this home for ten years, before Mr. Conrad died of a heart attack on the basement stairs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Lenox, Massachusetts to investigate The Mount, a location they first visited in 2008. Built in 1902, the Mount was designed and built for Pulitzer Prize winning author, Edith Wharton and her husband, Teddy. When their marriage started to fall apart in 1911, the couple moved out and eventually divorced. This renowned property is where Edith wrote many of her best sellers, and had famous friends visit, including Henry James.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Boston, Massachusetts to investigate the USS Constitution, the oldest commissioned warship still afloat in the world and one that also never lost a battle. She was built in 1794 and decommissioned in 1855, then placed in permanent commission in 1940. Today she holds a crew of 60, but at a peak time, during the War of 1812, she had 450-500 people aboard: including 60 marines, 350-400 sailors, and 50 officers/ship boys.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to North Adams, Massachusetts to investigate Houghton Mansion. It was built in 1897 for North Adams' first Mayor, A.C Houghton. Constructed on the foundation of a previous home, The Houghton Mansion was used for the family and fundraisers. The hauntings are said to have begun in 1914 after a tragic car accident took the lives of A.C Houghton and his daughter. His chauffer was driving and was so overcome with guilt that he took his own life the next day. A week later Mr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Glen Spey, New York to investigate Burn Brae Mansion, which was formerly the summer home of Margaret and Charles Elkin. It was constructed in the early 1900's by Margaret, who was one of seven MacKenzie siblings to build a grand estate in Glen Spey with the money given to her by her father. Several of Charles and Margaret's children passed away young, and their coachman, William attempted suicide on the property, and later died.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out by two clients to investigate the Midwest Railway Preservation Society in Cleveland, Ohio. Built in 1907, this rail yard had over 400 people working there 24/7. Some of the jobs were very dangerous with a number of injuries and deaths taking place over the years, with the brakeman being one of the most dangerous. Sometimes people fell off the tops of the trains and died.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On the season premiere of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cleveland, Ohio to investigate Grays Armory. It was built in 1893 to house the men's only Grays militia force, a force that was to protect the city of Cleveland from any unrest, as there was no National Guard at that point in time. The gray color was chosen to honor the New York grey's for being victorious during the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Detroit, Michigan to investigate The Whitney. Originally built in 1890 by lumber baron David Whitney, it was used as a private residence for him and his second wife, Sarah, along with his four children. At the time the house was built he was the wealthiest man in Detroit, and spared no expense in his home, including adding the first personal use elevator, and $400,000 worth of furnishings from two trips to Europe. Mr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Toledo, Ohio to investigate the Toledo Yacht Club. Susan Hurst has called the guys in to investigate the club, which first opened in 1865. A fire destroyed it in 1906 and it was rebuilt in 1908. It became well known during the prohibition era, as bootleggers used the docks to smuggle Canadian booze across Lake Erie.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Steve's hometown of New Bedford, Massachusetts to investigate Fort Taber-Fort Rodman. In the 1770's New Bedford was home to many Colony Pirates and in 1778 the Navy launched a raid on New Bedford on the same spot the fort sits today. Three colonists were killed and New Bedford was burned to the ground.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS stays local as they investigate the Varnum Memorial Armory in East Greenwich, Rhode Island. The armory was built in 1913 by the Varnum Continentals, Inc., a group that works to preserve the Rhode Island military history, and was to be used as a clubhouse and meeting hall for them. There are no reported deaths on the property, but they did hold wakes for soldiers that died during WWI and WWII.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called in to investigate Old Lake County Jail, in Crown Pint, Indiana. Originally built in 1882, the jail had 10 cells plus the attached sheriff house, which was required by Indiana law to have the Sheriff reside next to or in front of the jail. The prison went through two expansions, the first in 1908 and the second in 1928. At its peak the jail could hold 150 prisoners.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to Valparaiso, Indiana to investigate the Inn at Aberdeen. The house dates back to the 1850's and was purchased by the Ritter family, who were thought to be involved in the Underground Railroad. The house changed ownership over the years until the client, John, purchased it in 1995. Since then reports of paranormal activity have been accumulating.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS stays close to home by investigating the Westerly Library, in Westerly, Rhode Island. In 1892 Steven and Harriett Wilcox agreed to fund an in memoriam library in horror of Civil War soldiers. The library was completed in 1894, but unfortunately Mr. Wilcox did not live long enough to see it completed. The library has grown to over 50,000 square feet and has been designated as Rhode Island's first literary landmark.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out to the Garde Arts Center in New London, Connecticut. The Center is the former site of the Williams Family Mansion, built in1831 by Thomas Wheeler Williams. Mr. Williams was a congressman and part of the whaling community; in a city know as the "Whaling City." Thomas Wheeler Williams married twice having a total of 9 children. Tragically 5 of Thomas's children died under the age of 22yrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to Cornwall Bridge, Connecticut to investigate the Vogel Residence. Their client, Robin Vogel, is afraid that the Curse Of Dudleytown has spread to her home and has asked TAPS to help. Dudleytown was an abandoned settlement that dates back to the 1740's. Many people believe the settlement was cursed due to the fact that many inhabitants died a violent death or went insane. The Vogel Residence was originally built in 1780 with an addition put on in 1830.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Wilmington, Delaware to investigate Rockwood Museum. They are joined by two of their paranormal friends: actors Rachel Nichols, and Jonathan Sadowski. The original owner of the mansion was Joseph Shipley. He was born into a wealthy family in Wilmington, but made his own money as a merchant banker in Liverpool, England. He built Rockwood Mansion in 1854 to resemble his Liverpool home, Wyncote.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: We are introduced to Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson, co-founders and lead investigators for The Atlantic Paranormal Society (TAPS). Their Technical Manager, Brian Harnois, tells them of an interesting case. The home they are to investigate is in Altoona, PA which is several hours away, but because of the dramatic nature of the case they decide to make the long drive. They investigate reports of poltergeist activity in a home with a very young girl who seems to see the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates the historic Mishler Theatre and the Altoona Railroaders Memorial Museum. At the theater, the owner and employees have seen the late owner walking into the wall where his old office used to be, sitting in the seats, and have heard him walking on the catwalk above the stage. At the museum, the spirit of a railroad worker has been seen. Despite some orb activity in the theater, neither site presents any good evidence of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates The Lighthouse Inn in New London, Conn., which is reported to be haunted by the ghost of a bride who fell down a flight of stairs on her wedding day in 1930. Drops in temperature are recorded, and Steve feels someone touch him on his back when no one else is nearby. They then travel to Ashland, Mass. to a pub called Stone's Public House, formerly The Railroad House. Here, a little girl died after being hit by a train.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: At the request of the US Coast Guard, TAPS goes to Long Island Sound to investigate the Race Rock Lighthouse. The lighthouse is now automated, but the Coast Guard officers who come to do maintenance and inspection have reported strange occurrences and are nervous about going to the site. The commanding officers hope to disprove the rumors. The team's cameras pick up strange orb activity and a fog which the investigators do not remember from the time of the video.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates Eastern State Penitentiary, an abandoned prison with a long, colorful history and a reputation for paranormal activity. While there, they capture a strange, shadowy shape on film. After reviewing the film, Jason decides that the team should return. More orbs are caught on film, but no repeat of the shadowy figure. Efforts to duplicate the footage prove unsuccessful, but Jason and Grant see how it could have been done.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This investigation focuses on some friends of Brian's whose home is a deconsecrated 19th century church. They claim to have seen apparitions and to have heard strange noises. Also, one of the doors in the house opens by itself. The investigation turns up only orbs caused by dust. Jason determines that the sounds and orbs are caused by the settling of the wood beams when the church bell rings. The team is able to duplicate the opening door, giving a mundane explanation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to investigate an armory in New Bedford, Mass. In one room, the thermal imaging camera detects a warm mist passing in front of the lens. This is very strange, because mists are generally colder than the surrounding air. While moving along a catwalk, sound man Frank DeAngelis suddenly falls down and does not feel well enough to move for quite some time.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Reports of disturbances in a college student group house are easily explained as acoustics and encounters with neighbors who were drunk at the time. At the Topton House Pub, witnesses have reported that the ghost of a little girl sometimes trips people on the steps and has moved glasses of soda on one table. The daughter of the owner has also smelled roses while in the cellar and heard murmurring voices.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Mike Sinclair, the founder of O.R.I.O.N. Paranormal and a TAPS family member, has called in TAPS to co-investigate the New Boston Inn, in the Berkshires. After examining his findings, the TAPS team is able to disprove or cast doubt upon, everything he found. However, the experience their own incident when a pen seems to have moved with no one else nearby. Next they travel to Pittsburgh to investigate the home of Gloria and Genny.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates two cases. First they go to Albany, NY to the home of Linda Johnson. Linda claims to be psychically sensitive, and to have been accosted by a negative or ""demonic"" entity. No conclusive evidence is found, but Jason suggests that Keith Johnson contact her separately to try to help further. Next, they meet Adam Zubrowski, who seems to be experiencing strange events. The house was built by his grandparents, and his grandfather died there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to New Orleans to investigate one of the "most haunted" places in the U.S., and Brian's new relationship interferes with his work causing tension with TAPS members. They capture an image on their thermal camera and discover a lamp that moves on its own. Jason and Grant both agree that the plantation is haunted.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS helps a family whose young children claim to be tormented by ghosts. They find bones under the floorboards. After further analysis, the bones are not human but animal and the footage shows that the little boy, not ghosts, is waking up his sister in the middle of the night. Then TAPS helps a young woman who is experiencing lots of paranormal activity in her home. Jason is attacked and TAPS concludes that the entity is focused on the young woman.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to New Orleans for a case with a jealous female spirit who won't leave the male homeowner alone. They find evidence that supports the victim's claims when they viewfootage of a door that opens and shuts on its own. While in town, they go to Brennan's restaurant for a meal and some ghost hunting. But their EVPs are tainted by noises that are coming from a private party.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian can't go on this road trip. A training mission in North Carolina goes awry when team members get food poisoning. A local ghost hunting group asks TAPS for help with a haunted battleship. Jason and Grant are chased through the bowels of the ship. There are a lot of personal experiences but the team fails to capture anything on tape. The results are inconclusive.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian asks Jason and Grant for some time off. TAPS visits a local playhouse with a long history of hauntings but their investigation doesn't yield any evidence. Then they head over to a firehouse where the paranormal activity is spooking some of the volunteer firemen. Jason and Grant have an odd experience with a stereo that turns itself on. Andy tries to debunk some alarms that get tripped on their own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian leaves TAPS. Andy persuades Jason and Grant to investigate a haunted lighthouse. Steve and Andy experience a cold spot but nothing else happens. Jason and Grant tell Andy he should be more diligent with his case studies. TAPS travel to New York for a haunted museum. Andy gets in a tiff with the other members. The team doesn't capture any evidence of a haunting.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Steve gets promoted to Tech Manager. TAPS takes on a case that has a personal connection for Kristyn, one of their members. A little boy claims he is being attacked by an entity while his mother suffers dizzy spells whenever she's in the basement. The team discovers high EMF readings and concludes this could be the cause of the dizzy spells since there carbon monoxide leaks weren't detected.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS searches for paranormal evidence at a lavish historical estate in Rhode Island. They debunk the cold spots in the basement when they find a blocked heating system. They do not find any evidence of a haunting. A young and inexperienced paranormal group in New Jersey contacts TAPS for help because they are out of their league. The victim is so frightened she won't allow herself to be seen on camera. TAPS captures recorded sounds of footsteps in her home just as she had reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS welcomes an investigator in training, Dave Tango, from the NJ group. The team goes to a home in New Hampshire where the teenage boys are so afraid of the paranormal activity that they want to move. Grant gets attacked by a drum. TAPS heads the upstate NY to investigate a former insane asylum. They gather no evidence but run into some dive-bombing bats.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS returns to Philadelphia's Eastern State Penitentiary to track down an apparition; the team investigates a haunted vacation home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to California to investigate two locations at the top of their Most Haunted list. The first stop is the Winchester Mystery House in San Jose where Dave and Donna's inexperience in the tech department starts to annoy Steve. Jason and Grant debunk cold spots. They don't capture any evidence of paranormal activity. At the Queen Mary in Long Beach, the team seems overwhelmed by the size of the ship. Jason, Grant and Steve are able to debunk some of the ghostly activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to Ohio to investigate Mansfield State Penitentiary, the location of The Shawshank Redemption film. Dave and Dustin chase a dark shadow down one of the cell blocks. Jason and Grant hear an unseen visitor running on the walkway above them. The team fails to collect any ghostly evidence. They head to Massachusetts and investigate the former home of the infamous Lizzie Borden who was accused of viciously murdering her father and step-mother with an axe.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has been called to Arkansas to investigate a haunted hotel. Dustin discovers that Grant's computer bag has mysteriously moved on its own. Jason and Grant capture an apparition, "the holy grail", on their thermal camera. The team is welcomed into a medium's home, the most haunted house in the town. Dustin and Dave check out the spooky hollow down the road but don't find anything paranormal. Grant captures some unusual activity on the thermal cam while recording the medium reading Jason.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Kentucky to investigate one of the most haunted places in the country, Waverly Hills Sanatorium. During the decades the facility served as a tuberculosis hospital, where an estimated 63,000 people died within its walls. Over two nights of extensive investigation, the members of TAPS have a variety of inexplicable encounters and eerie personal experiences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to searches Holliston, Massachusetts to help a family that has a spirit haunting their home. Loud footsteps are frequently heard up and down the staircase, an apparition has appeared in the master bedroom, and a voice has been heard yelling "mommy". Their young daughter is so terrified that she refuses to step foot in the basement and does not feel comfortable anywhere in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Jason's hometown of Canandaigua, in upstate New York, to investigate two reported hauntings. A sinister force seems to be at work in the Leonard household. The homeowners have encountered various unsettling noises and events, including witnessing a full bodied apparition in their infant son's bedroom. Concern turned to panic when the homeowners discovered scratches on the back of their infant son's neck. TAPS arrives to uncover what is plaguing the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS answers an urgent call from a homeowner in Clinton, Massachusetts, who is being plagued by a disturbing spirit. Aided by Mike Dion, a member of the New England Paranormal Group, TAPS explores the home and immediately feels an uncomfortable presence throughout. Events escalate until Grant is knocked to his knees. Donna is visibly horrified by Grant's experience, but pushes on with the investigation to find out what other surprises the night may hold.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A frightened family in Glen Gardner, New Jersey calls TAPS for assistance from a menacing shadowy figure that is haunting their home. Hilary and Sean Hodgman have regularly witnessed mysterious black apparitions moving across their master bedroom. Through their investigation, TAPS encounters a series of bizarre sensations and encounters in the home. The team even captures an audio recording of a voice which is heard saying "we are coming.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Florida to investigate the paranormal activities at the historical St. Augustine Lighthouse. Armed with some new equipment, the TAPS team investigates the numerous accounts of inexplicable voices, noises and apparitions that have been reported for decades. Steve must confront his fear of heights in order to investigate the towering lighthouse, which is one of the tallest in the country. Immediately after setting up, TAPS begins to experience all sorts of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Roselle Park, New Jersey to investigate an Italian restaurant that is being plagued by a deceased former owner. Current employees believe such incidents as stools being knockedover can be attributed to a former owner, Eda, who died decades earlier in the building. The TAPS team sets out to prove whether or not Eda still lingers on the premises.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Guthrie, Oklahoma to investigate The Stone Lion Inn, a bed and breakfast experiencing paranormal phenomenon. A man dressed in Victorian attire has repeatedly been witnessed by visitors and employees of the former funeral parlor. During the investigation, a number of disturbing audio recordings are captured, including the chilling voice of a child asking "can you find me?" At one point, during the still of the night, Grant even hears his own name being whispered.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Stanley Hotel, the location that inspired Stephen King's classic novel "The Shining", is the setting for this TAPS investigation. The team travels to Estes Park, Colorado to explore The Stanley Hotel and discover what truth lies behind the fiction of the famous thriller. During the tour, TAPS is presented with stories of apparition sightings, noises of a large party coming from an empty ballroom, and even a horrifying case of apparent possession.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The season begins with the TAPS members traveling to Tombstone, Arizona to investigate the wild spirits of the old west. The group heads to the historic Birdcage Theatre, which in addition to housing performances, also served as a dancehall, saloon and casino after it opened in 1881.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS continue their investigation into the paranormal history of the old west by heading to Bisbee, Arizona to uncover the secrets at The Copper Queen Hotel. Built in 1902, the establishment is brimming with frequent sightings of numerous apparitions. These include a little boy named Billy, who is believed to have drowned in a nearby river. Some of the most startling encounters have taken place in the "Julia Lowell Room" where, long ago, a woman of the same name committed suicide.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Vermont, a terrified family calls upon TAPS for assistance with startling paranormal events that are taking place in their home. Since they began renovating, the Johnsons have repeatedly seen so-called "shadow people" moving through their house. One night while sleeping, Sean Johnson, the patriarch of the home, was attacked by forces that cannot be seen.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Massachusetts, TAPS explores a Victorian mansion with a bizarre history of unexplained activity. The historic home recently underwent a stage of renovation which seems to have stirred up an abundance of paranormal phenomena. The homeowners have seen a number of apparitions dressed in period clothing throughout the mansion. Mysterious voices and strange noises have also been a common occurrence.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this special episode, TAPS presents investigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the unprecedented live broadcast from The Stanley Hotel in Estes Park, Colorado. Nearly 30 years ago, Stephen King's strange encounters during his stay at the establishment prompted him to write the classic horror novel "The Shining". During their intense investigation, TAPS experiences an incredible amount of paranormal activity in the rooms, halls and in the underbelly of the notorious hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this special episode, TAPS presents investigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the unprecedented live broadcast from The Stanley Hotel in Estes Park, Colorado. Nearly 30 years ago, Stephen King's strange encounters during his stay at the establishment prompted him to write the classic horror novel "The Shining". During their intense investigation, TAPS experiences an incredible amount of paranormal activity in the rooms, halls and in the underbelly of the notorious hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For their first overseas investigation, TAPS travels to Ireland to explore the legendary Leap Castle. Hundreds of years old, the historic grounds are said to be the home to numerous malevolent spirits, but none more frightening than a mysterious entity known as the "Elemental". Witnesses claim that the Elemental is an evil energy created from the castle's bloody past, where it served as a place of torture and brutal murder.

programme.desc: For their first overseas investigation, TAPS travels to Ireland to explore the legendary Leap Castle. Witnesses claim that the Elemental is an evil energy created from the castle's bloody past, where it served as a place of torture and brutal murder.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Continuing their investigation in Europe, TAPS explores the mysterious Lisheen Ruins in Ireland. These ancient ruins of a grand yet cursed estate are reportedly home to "fairies", troll-like spirits that live underground and wreak havoc on those who trespass. During an intense investigation, the team sets out to learn the truth behind the legends. What was already an unusual investigation turns to panic as TAPS realize they are being hunted by something from the beyond.

programme.desc: Continuing their investigation in Europe, TAPS explores the mysterious Lisheen Ruins in Ireland. programme.title: Esther
programme.desc: Following the conquest of Babylon, the King of Persia gives a banquet for his people, but his wife, Vashti, refuses to attend. Ahasuerus disowns Vashti and goes in search of her replacement. In his harem, he meets the young girl Esther and falls in love with her. Esther then reveals to Ahasuerus that she is Jewish and asks him to show her people mercy.

programme.title: Solomon
programme.desc: Solomon is crowned King of Israel and rules the land with love, peace and respect. While visiting the city, Solomon meets the beautiful Queen of Sheba and falls in love. When she returns to her homeland, Solomon falls into a deep depression, departing from his once idyllic world of peace and luxury while his kingdom threatens to collapse.

programme.title: The Apocalypse
programme.desc: From the Emmy Award-winning Bible Collection comes a production starring Richard Harris as the Apostle John. Detailing John's visions against the backdrop of the severe persecution of Christians in the first century, this biblically based film will inspire viewers.

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: The church's greatest enemy became Christ's most prolific messenger. Beautifully shot in the Moroccan desert, Paul the Apostle is a sweeping saga of the man who brought the Gospel to the Western world.

programme.title: Jeremiah
programme.desc: Jeremiah tells the story of the prophet who abandons his family and the woman he loves in order to relay God's message in Jerusalem. Although he is persecuted and branded as a traitor for warning others of the destruction of the Holy City, he continues fearlessly with his mission. When his prophecy is fulfilled, he experiences first-hand Jerusalem's destruction by the Babylonians.

programme.title: Return to the Hiding Place
programme.desc: When the Nazis begin killing Jews in Holland, a group of youth fight to save the lives of the innocent.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Approximately 2,500 prophecies appear in the Bible and 2,000 have been fulfilled. Did biblical prophets have special abilities that allowed them to foretell the future? Has modern technology actually created the devices for these ancient predictions of impending disasters to come true? Explore the predictions of the prophets, then decide for yourself: Are ancient prophecies today's reality?

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Since the dawn of the new millennium predictions of the apocalypse have reached a fever pitch. Some scholars believe the Bible tells us there will be a mysterious event called 'The Rapture'. Many believe in the 'second coming' of Christ. Will there be a 'third' coming as well? Could there be a formula hidden in the Book of Revelation? The answers are at once hopeful and frightening.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: The story of Adam and Eve in the book of Genesis is the most controversial story in the Bible. What are archaeologists, paleontologists, biologists and theologians saying today? Is the story fact or fiction? The evidence may shock you. Where was the Garden of Eden? What was it like? Does it still exist, if indeed it ever did? Explore the evidence and journey back to the original birthplace of man.

Has modern technology finally answered these questions?

Was the outcome of this conflict foretold by biblical writings thousands of years earlier?

programme.title: A Moment in History
programme.desc: Seth explores the final 24 hours in the life of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: Jesus and the Early Church
programme.desc: John was called by Jesus from the shores of the Sea of Galilee to come and follow him. For 3 years he was one of the inner-band of disciples, witnessing the transfiguration. After the death of Jesus, he was first at the tomb to discover that Jesus had risen. He became leader of the church at Ephesus where he wrote the Gospel of John. In the mines of Patmos, he had a wonderful vision of God.

programme.title: Scarlet Woman: The True Story of Mary Magdalene
programme.desc: Mary Magdalene is a familiar presence in modern culture. We've read about her in the Da Vinci Code. We've heard about her in Jesus Christ Superstar. We think we know the story well. Yet in actual fact we don't know it at all because it's all a fantasy. For a thousand years, the Mary Magdalene story has been one of art's most tremulous myths. In the Bible, she warrants just four actual mentions.

programme.title: Jesus The Desire Of Ages
programme.desc: Jesus: The Desire of Ages tells the familiar story in a fresh way, through the eyes of those who knew and loved the Son of Man. An inspiring and triumphant music score combined with imaginative visual artistry will grip your heart as you experience the reality of Jesus' ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: The Last Hours of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: From his arrest to his resurrection, a lot of questions still surround the last hours of Jesus' life. Recent discoveries and eXperts' analysis shed some light on this enigma. Did Jesus really dies on the cross? Follow this investigation on one of History's biggest mysteries.

programme.title: Jesus and the Early Church
programme.desc: James and Jude were the brothers of Jesus, who like Jesus, grew up in their father's carpenters shop in Nazareth. It was only after Jesus' death and resurrection that they became his followers, with James heading up the Jerusalem Church. Each of them wrote letters to the believers with James encouraging them to do good deeds as well as believe.

programme.title: The Twelve Apostles: The First 12 Men Chosen By Jesus
programme.desc: Judas has been the symbol of evil and treachery but does he deserve this reputation? Why has he continued to fascinate writers, actors and artists? It is time to re-examine his role in the Jesus story and in the centuries that followed.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: An investigation into the identity of Mary Magdalene, one the Bible's best known women, produces startling insights. Who was she? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or Christ's beloved disciple?

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: Is it the cloth that covered Jesus in the tomb? A silent witness to the greatest event in history? What are its secrets? New evidence reveals the truth.

programme.title: The Shroud: Face to Face
programme.desc: Robert Orlando's documentary portrays Jesus' crucifixion as a transformative true crime story. It uses New Testament insights, expert interviews, and digital recreations to examine the Shroud of Turin. Bloodstains align with gospel accounts, suggesting authenticity. Orlando hopes to renew interest in Christian history.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: The Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Are these silent early years of Jesus really lost? The answers may surprise you!

programme.title: Tomb of Jesus: The Evidence
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Charlton Heston Presents The Bible (Widescreen)
programme.desc: The life, ministry and message of Jesus Christ. Here is the story of His humble birth in a Bethlehem manger, His baptism in the River Jordan and of His calling of the disciples. Witness Jesus' temptation in the wilderness, the Sermon on the Mount, the healing of the blind and many miracles.

programme.title: I Believe In Easter
programme.desc: Learn how the church adapted and transformed pagan tradition into the celebration of the Resurrection. See how culture, emperors, apostles and popes have influenced how we celebrate Easter today.

programme.title: The Week That Changed The World
programme.desc: The resurrection happened. It's not just the belief of Christians, it's borne out by history, archaeology, and science. This documentary takes viewers step by step through the events of Holy Week-shedding light on the key players, unraveling the political intrigue, and answering long standing questions about what happened, and why. Professor of ancient history and world-renowned expert Dr. Paul L.

programme.title: Prophecies of the Passion
programme.desc: Prophecies of the Passion is an extraordinary look at the Messianic prophecies fulfilled during the final week of Christ's life on earth. The Gospels clearly describe Jesus' betrayal, arrest, death, and resurrection. Remarkably, these events were foretold by Hebrew prophets-in specific detail... centuries before they actually occurred.

programme.title: Twelve Ordinary Men
programme.desc: A look at the twelve disciples who were hand-picked by Jesus to learn from his teachings, and spread the gospel after his crucifixion. Why these men?

programme.title: Charlton Heston Presents The Bible (Widescreen)

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rafael le ofrece "merca" a Mónica a cambio de información sobre Casillas y ella saca las garras. Extraditan a Felina. Aurelio va tras Emiliana.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rafael le ofrece "merca" a Mónica a cambio de información sobre Casillas y ella saca las garras. Extraditan a Felina. Aurelio va tras Emiliana.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas está de cacería tras Emiliana. Amenaza con comérsela viva. Investigan el pasado de Rutila y aunque niega todo, cuando Castillo se va, ella se quiebra. Él está muy cerca de la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas está de cacería tras Emiliana. Amenaza con comérsela viva. Investigan el pasado de Rutila y aunque niega todo, cuando Castillo se va, ella se quiebra. Él está muy cerca de la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica se abre camino en México para hacer negocios a lo grande. El presidente la espera en Toluca y allí ventilan el pasado. Salazar desenreda el negocio de las metanfetaminas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor pone una condición y es inflexible. Aurelio y sus hombres armados preparan el ataque contra él. Las cuatro toneladas de cocaína van rumbo a su destino. Mónica rechaza a Omar como hombre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Se desata la balacera. Aurelio accionó el arma y su blanco fue Víctor, Casillas cree que lo mató. Todos se retiran, la Marina está por llegar. Tony Pastrana está a punto de ser excarcelado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Omar decide ocultar información a la prensa. Rodrigo asegura a Salazar y a Colón que se quedará a su lado para destapar al narco presidente. Se entera de que Sebastián es un infiltrado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio va a Cuba y se reúne con Penumbra para hacer negocios, pero no todo sale bien. Casillas amenaza con romper el tratado de paz. Víctor decide trabajar a escondidas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Nace la alianza entre Tony Pastrana y Mónica Robles. Ella jura vengarse de Aurelio cuando se levante, por haberle quitado a su hijo. El presidente pierde la compostura, al sentirse amenazado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Esperanza explica el organigrama del narcotráfico en Colombia, México y Venezuela. Confirma al FBI que Casillas vive. Aurelio va a Colombia y se lleva una sorpresa. Alba enfrenta a Víctor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Emiliana no le perdona a Casillas que matara a Lourdes. El cerco del FBI empieza a funcionar. Javi y Mónica son aliados.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los padres de Esperanza, Juan Carlos y Pina, están preocupados por su desaparición y sus presuntos vínculos con el narcotráfico. Ella, muerta de miedo, le pide a Salazar que no la abandone.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Colón garantiza la vida de Esperanza, como Marta Rangel. Ella le advierte sobre el Diablo que acaba de despertar. Javi visita a la Felina como aliado de Casillas. Dalvio sufre una emboscada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Dalvio y Víctor se enfrentan con armas. Cansado, Dalvio enfrenta a Aurelio y se amenazan con pistolas. Colón traslada a Esperanza como testigo protegido a una casa de seguridad.

programme.desc: Aurelio planea todo para intervenir la cuenta de Rutila, quiere sacar cinco millones de dólares. Ismael, molesto con su padre. Se cae el negocio de Mónica. Piensa en Rutila para lavar dinero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pastrana piensa en el punto débil de Aurelio para vengarse. Colón y Rodrigo hablan de él y el ascenso de la droga en Estados Unidos. Rutila nota que la robaron. Doble 30 y Mónica planean la última carga.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio confirma su traición a Feyo Aguilera. Le sugieren no enfrentar a las Maras y las Emes, que el gobierno lo haga, pero él rechaza la idea. Víctor quiere recuperar a Mónica. Rastrean a la Tata.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Una furibunda Rutila encara a su padre, por robarle su dinero. Pastrana ubica a uno de los hijos de Aurelio. Mónica reclama a Víctor la trata de blancas. Penumbra intenta extorsionar a Javier.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tony Pastrana llega a Colombia para vengarse de los Casillas. Ordena el primer asesinato. Interrogan a Arelys y, asustada, informa sobre Juan Carlos y Pina. Rivero vigila a Dalvio y la Tata.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doble 30 le ofrece tres toneladas de droga a Aurelio. Casillas protesta. El paramilitar lo amenaza con entregarlo a las autoridades o a Víctor. Mónica pide que la dejen ir. Víctor se deprime.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El recado de Tony llega a oídos de Aurelio. Casillas enfurece por la muerte de su hijo, Nazareno. Piensa en la guerra que se desatará y cómo cuidarse. Tocan el corazón de la Felina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Inauguran el local de Víctor, pero pronto la fiesta se convertirá en un escenario de horror y pánico. Juan Carlos intenta sobornar a un agente federal. La Felina recibe una visita inesperada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

He finds himself reassuring his more ethically challenged younger brother, Vitaly (Jared Leto), while adeptly sidestepping the pursuit of federal agent Jack Lawrence (Ethan Hawke). The globetrotting arms dealer also pursues the woman of his dreams, supermodel Ava Fontaine (Bridget Moynahan).
